# Three.js Shaders

## Quick Start

```javascript
import * as THREE from "three";

const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    time: { value: 0 },
    color: { value: new THREE.Color(0xff0000) },
  },
  vertexShader: `
    void main() {
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    uniform vec3 color;

    void main() {
      gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});

// Update in animation loop
material.uniforms.time.value = clock.getElapsedTime();
```

## ShaderMaterial vs RawShaderMaterial

### ShaderMaterial

Three.js provides built-in uniforms and attributes.

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    // Built-in uniforms available:
    // uniform mat4 modelMatrix;
    // uniform mat4 modelViewMatrix;
    // uniform mat4 projectionMatrix;
    // uniform mat4 viewMatrix;
    // uniform mat3 normalMatrix;
    // uniform vec3 cameraPosition;

    // Built-in attributes available:
    // attribute vec3 position;
    // attribute vec3 normal;
    // attribute vec2 uv;

    void main() {
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    void main() {
      gl_FragColor = vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

### RawShaderMaterial

Full control - you define everything.

```javascript
const material = new THREE.RawShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    projectionMatrix: { value: camera.projectionMatrix },
    modelViewMatrix: { value: new THREE.Matrix4() },
  },
  vertexShader: `
    precision highp float;

    attribute vec3 position;
    uniform mat4 projectionMatrix;
    uniform mat4 modelViewMatrix;

    void main() {
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    precision highp float;

    void main() {
      gl_FragColor = vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

## Uniforms

### Uniform Types

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    // Numbers
    floatValue: { value: 1.5 },
    intValue: { value: 1 },

    // Vectors
    vec2Value: { value: new THREE.Vector2(1, 2) },
    vec3Value: { value: new THREE.Vector3(1, 2, 3) },
    vec4Value: { value: new THREE.Vector4(1, 2, 3, 4) },

    // Colors (converted to vec3)
    colorValue: { value: new THREE.Color(0xff0000) },

    // Matrices
    mat3Value: { value: new THREE.Matrix3() },
    mat4Value: { value: new THREE.Matrix4() },

    // Textures
    textureValue: { value: texture },
    cubeTextureValue: { value: cubeTexture },

    // Arrays
    floatArray: { value: [1.0, 2.0, 3.0] },
    vec3Array: {
      value: [new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0)],
    },
  },
});
```

### GLSL Declarations

```glsl
// In shader
uniform float floatValue;
uniform int intValue;
uniform vec2 vec2Value;
uniform vec3 vec3Value;
uniform vec3 colorValue;    // Color becomes vec3
uniform vec4 vec4Value;
uniform mat3 mat3Value;
uniform mat4 mat4Value;
uniform sampler2D textureValue;
uniform samplerCube cubeTextureValue;
uniform float floatArray[3];
uniform vec3 vec3Array[2];
```

### Updating Uniforms

```javascript
// Direct assignment
material.uniforms.time.value = clock.getElapsedTime();

// Vector/Color updates
material.uniforms.position.value.set(x, y, z);
material.uniforms.color.value.setHSL(hue, 1, 0.5);

// Matrix updates
material.uniforms.matrix.value.copy(mesh.matrixWorld);
```

## Varyings

Pass data from vertex to fragment shader.

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec2 vUv;
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vPosition;

    void main() {
      vUv = uv;
      vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
      vPosition = (modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0)).xyz;

      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    varying vec2 vUv;
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vPosition;

    void main() {
      // Use interpolated values
      gl_FragColor = vec4(vNormal * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

## Common Shader Patterns

### Texture Sampling

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    map: { value: texture },
  },
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec2 vUv;

    void main() {
      vUv = uv;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    uniform sampler2D map;
    varying vec2 vUv;

    void main() {
      vec4 texColor = texture2D(map, vUv);
      gl_FragColor = texColor;
    }
  `,
});
```

### Vertex Displacement

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    time: { value: 0 },
    amplitude: { value: 0.5 },
  },
  vertexShader: `
    uniform float time;
    uniform float amplitude;

    void main() {
      vec3 pos = position;

      // Wave displacement
      pos.z += sin(pos.x * 5.0 + time) * amplitude;
      pos.z += sin(pos.y * 5.0 + time) * amplitude;

      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(pos, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    void main() {
      gl_FragColor = vec4(0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

### Fresnel Effect

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

    void main() {
      vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
      vWorldPosition = (modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0)).xyz;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

    void main() {
      // cameraPosition is auto-provided by ShaderMaterial
      vec3 viewDirection = normalize(cameraPosition - vWorldPosition);
      float fresnel = pow(1.0 - dot(viewDirection, vNormal), 3.0);

      vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.5);
      vec3 fresnelColor = vec3(0.5, 0.8, 1.0);

      gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(baseColor, fresnelColor, fresnel), 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

### Noise-Based Effects

```glsl
// Simple noise function
float random(vec2 st) {
  return fract(sin(dot(st.xy, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
}

// Value noise
float noise(vec2 st) {
  vec2 i = floor(st);
  vec2 f = fract(st);

  float a = random(i);
  float b = random(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));
  float c = random(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));
  float d = random(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));

  vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);

  return mix(a, b, u.x) + (c - a) * u.y * (1.0 - u.x) + (d - b) * u.x * u.y;
}

// Usage
float n = noise(vUv * 10.0 + time);
```

### Gradient

```glsl
// Linear gradient
vec3 color = mix(colorA, colorB, vUv.y);

// Radial gradient
float dist = distance(vUv, vec2(0.5));
vec3 color = mix(centerColor, edgeColor, dist * 2.0);

// Smooth gradient with custom curve
float t = smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, vUv.y);
vec3 color = mix(colorA, colorB, t);
```

### Rim Lighting

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vViewPosition;

    void main() {
      vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
      vec4 mvPosition = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      vViewPosition = mvPosition.xyz;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mvPosition;
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vViewPosition;

    void main() {
      vec3 viewDir = normalize(-vViewPosition);
      float rim = 1.0 - max(0.0, dot(viewDir, vNormal));
      rim = pow(rim, 4.0);

      vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.2, 0.2, 0.8);
      vec3 rimColor = vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0);

      gl_FragColor = vec4(baseColor + rimColor * rim, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

### Dissolve Effect

```glsl
uniform float progress;
uniform sampler2D noiseMap;

void main() {
  float noise = texture2D(noiseMap, vUv).r;

  if (noise < progress) {
    discard;
  }

  // Edge glow
  float edge = smoothstep(progress, progress + 0.1, noise);
  vec3 edgeColor = vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0);
  vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.5);

  gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(edgeColor, baseColor, edge), 1.0);
}
```

## Extending Built-in Materials

### onBeforeCompile

Modify existing material shaders.

```javascript
const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x00ff00 });

material.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
  // Add custom uniform
  shader.uniforms.time = { value: 0 };

  // Store reference for updates
  material.userData.shader = shader;

  // Modify vertex shader
  shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader.replace(
    "#include <begin_vertex>",
    `
    #include <begin_vertex>
    transformed.y += sin(position.x * 10.0 + time) * 0.1;
    `,
  );

  // Add uniform declaration
  shader.vertexShader = "uniform float time;\n" + shader.vertexShader;
};

// Update in animation loop
if (material.userData.shader) {
  material.userData.shader.uniforms.time.value = clock.getElapsedTime();
}
```

### Common Injection Points

```javascript
// Vertex shader chunks
"#include <begin_vertex>"; // After position is calculated
"#include <project_vertex>"; // After gl_Position
"#include <beginnormal_vertex>"; // Normal calculation start

// Fragment shader chunks
"#include <color_fragment>"; // After diffuse color
"#include <output_fragment>"; // Final output
"#include <fog_fragment>"; // After fog applied
```

## GLSL Built-in Functions

### Math Functions

```glsl
// Basic
abs(x), sign(x), floor(x), ceil(x), fract(x)
mod(x, y), min(x, y), max(x, y), clamp(x, min, max)
mix(a, b, t), step(edge, x), smoothstep(edge0, edge1, x)

// Trigonometry
sin(x), cos(x), tan(x)
asin(x), acos(x), atan(y, x), atan(x)
radians(degrees), degrees(radians)

// Exponential
pow(x, y), exp(x), log(x), exp2(x), log2(x)
sqrt(x), inversesqrt(x)
```

### Vector Functions

```glsl
// Length and distance
length(v), distance(p0, p1), dot(x, y), cross(x, y)

// Normalization
normalize(v)

// Reflection and refraction
reflect(I, N), refract(I, N, eta)

// Component-wise
lessThan(x, y), lessThanEqual(x, y)
greaterThan(x, y), greaterThanEqual(x, y)
equal(x, y), notEqual(x, y)
any(bvec), all(bvec)
```

### Texture Functions

```glsl
// GLSL 1.0 (default) - use texture2D/textureCube
texture2D(sampler, coord)
texture2D(sampler, coord, bias)
textureCube(sampler, coord)

// GLSL 3.0 (glslVersion: THREE.GLSL3) - use texture()
// texture(sampler, coord) replaces texture2D/textureCube
// Also use: out vec4 fragColor instead of gl_FragColor

// Texture size (GLSL 1.30+)
textureSize(sampler, lod)
```

## Shader Includes

### Using Three.js Shader Chunks

```javascript
import { ShaderChunk } from "three";

const fragmentShader = `
  ${ShaderChunk.common}
  ${ShaderChunk.packing}

  uniform sampler2D depthTexture;
  varying vec2 vUv;

  void main() {
    float depth = texture2D(depthTexture, vUv).r;
    float linearDepth = perspectiveDepthToViewZ(depth, 0.1, 1000.0);
    gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(-linearDepth / 100.0), 1.0);
  }
`;
```

### External Shader Files

```javascript
// With vite/webpack
import vertexShader from "./shaders/vertex.glsl";
import fragmentShader from "./shaders/fragment.glsl";

const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader,
  fragmentShader,
});
```

## Instanced Shaders

```javascript
// Instanced attribute
const offsets = new Float32Array(instanceCount * 3);
// Fill offsets...
geometry.setAttribute("offset", new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(offsets, 3));

const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    attribute vec3 offset;

    void main() {
      vec3 pos = position + offset;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(pos, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    void main() {
      gl_FragColor = vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

`;

// Check WebGL errors
renderer.debug.checkShaderErrors = true;

## Performance Tips

1. **Minimize uniforms**: Group related values into vectors
2. **Avoid conditionals**: Use mix/step instead of if/else
3. **Precalculate**: Move calculations to JS when possible
4. **Use textures**: For complex functions, use lookup tables
5. **Limit overdraw**: Avoid transparent objects when possible

```glsl
// Instead of:
if (value > 0.5) {
  color = colorA;
} else {
  color = colorB;
}

// Use:
color = mix(colorB, colorA, step(0.5, value));
```

390:   // Smooth/stepped color-ramp lookup over a fixed-size vec4 palette.
391:   // steps=0 → smooth, steps>0 → quantised globally.
392:   // stepsPerColor>0 → quantise within each color segment.
393:   // softness controls blend sharpness (0=hard, 1=fully smooth).

396:   colorRampLookup: `
397: vec4 colorRampLookup(float t, vec4 colors[10], int count, int steps, float softness, int stepsPerColor, bool wrap) {
398:   int n = max(count, 1);
399:   if (n == 1) return colors[0];
400:   float tc = clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);
401:   if (wrap) tc = fract(tc);
402:   if (steps > 0) {
403:     float fSteps = float(steps);

640:     case 'sampler2D':

644:       return `bindPaletteUniform(gl, prog, '${name}', ${expr}, ${len})`

299: export function toProcessedHeatmap(file: File | string): Promise<{ blob: Blob }> {
300:   const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
301:   const canvasSize = 1000;
302: 
303:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
304:     const image = new Image();
305:     image.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
306: 
307:     image.addEventListener('load', () => {
308:       if (typeof file === 'string' ? file.endsWith('.svg') : file.type === 'image/svg+xml') {
309:         // Force SVG to load at a high fidelity size if it's an SVG
310:         image.width = canvasSize;
311:         image.height = canvasSize;
312:       }
313: 
314:       const ratio = image.naturalWidth / image.naturalHeight;
315: 
316:       const maxBlur = Math.floor(canvasSize * 0.15);
317:       const padding = Math.ceil(maxBlur * 2.5);
318:       let imgWidth = canvasSize;
319:       let imgHeight = canvasSize;
320:       if (ratio > 1) {
321:         imgHeight = Math.floor(canvasSize / ratio);
322:       } else {
323:         imgWidth = Math.floor(canvasSize * ratio);
324:       }
325: 
326:       canvas.width = imgWidth + 2 * padding;
327:       canvas.height = imgHeight + 2 * padding;
328: 
329:       const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
330:       if (!ctx) {
331:         throw new Error('Failed to get canvas 2d context');
332:       }
333: 
334:       // 1) Draw original image once, no filters
335:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
336:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
337:       ctx.drawImage(image, padding, padding, imgWidth, imgHeight);
338: 
339:       const { width, height } = canvas;
340:       const srcImageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, width, height);
341:       const src = srcImageData.data; // RGBA
342: 
343:       // 2) Build grayscale array (luma)
344:       const totalPixels = width * height;
345:       const gray = new Uint8ClampedArray(totalPixels);
346:       for (let i = 0; i < totalPixels; i++) {
347:         const px = i * 4;
348:         const r = src[px] ?? 0;
349:         const g = src[px + 1] ?? 0;
350:         const b = src[px + 2] ?? 0;
351:         // Standard luma conversion
352:         gray[i] = (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) | 0;
353:       }
354: 
355:       // 3) Blur grayscale for each "filter" you previously used
356:       const bigBlurRadius = maxBlur;
357:       const innerBlurRadius = Math.max(1, Math.round(0.12 * maxBlur));
358:       const contourRadius = 5;
359: 
360:       const bigBlurGray = multiPassBlurGray(gray, width, height, bigBlurRadius, 3);
361:       const innerBlurGray = multiPassBlurGray(gray, width, height, innerBlurRadius, 3);
362:       const contourGray = multiPassBlurGray(gray, width, height, contourRadius, 1);
363: 
364:       // 4) Combine into final ImageData
365:       const processedImageData = ctx.createImageData(width, height);
366:       const dst = processedImageData.data;
367: 
368:       for (let i = 0; i < totalPixels; i++) {
369:         const px = i * 4;
370:         dst[px] = contourGray[i] ?? 0;
371:         dst[px + 1] = bigBlurGray[i] ?? 0;
372:         dst[px + 2] = innerBlurGray[i] ?? 0;
373:         dst[px + 3] = 255;
374:       }
375: 
376:       ctx.putImageData(processedImageData, 0, 0);
377: 
378:       canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
379:         if (!blob) {
380:           reject(new Error('Failed to create PNG blob'));
381:           return;
382:         }
383:         resolve({ blob });
384:       }, 'image/png');
385:     });
386: 
387:     image.addEventListener('error', () => {
388:       reject(new Error('Failed to load image'));
389:     });
390: 
391:     image.src = typeof file === 'string' ? file : URL.createObjectURL(file);
392:   });
393: }
394: 
395: /**
396:  * Fast box blur for grayscale images using an integral image.
397:  * gray: Uint8ClampedArray of length width * height
398:  * radius: blur radius in pixels
399:  */
400: function blurGray(gray: Uint8ClampedArray, width: number, height: number, radius: number): Uint8ClampedArray {
401:   if (radius <= 0) {
402:     return gray.slice();
403:   }
404: 
405:   const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(width * height);
406:   const integral = new Uint32Array(width * height);
407: 
408:   // Build integral image
409:   for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
410:     let rowSum = 0;
411:     for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
412:       const idx = y * width + x;
413:       const v = gray[idx] ?? 0;
414:       rowSum += v;
415:       integral[idx] = rowSum + (y > 0 ? (integral[idx - width] ?? 0) : 0);
416:     }
417:   }
418: 
419:   // Blur using integral image
420:   for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
421:     const y1 = Math.max(0, y - radius);
422:     const y2 = Math.min(height - 1, y + radius);
423:     for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
424:       const x1 = Math.max(0, x - radius);
425:       const x2 = Math.min(width - 1, x + radius);
426: 
427:       const idxA = y2 * width + x2;
428:       const idxB = y2 * width + (x1 - 1);
429:       const idxC = (y1 - 1) * width + x2;
430:       const idxD = (y1 - 1) * width + (x1 - 1);
431: 
432:       const A = integral[idxA] ?? 0;
433:       const B = x1 > 0 ? (integral[idxB] ?? 0) : 0;
434:       const C = y1 > 0 ? (integral[idxC] ?? 0) : 0;
435:       const D = x1 > 0 && y1 > 0 ? (integral[idxD] ?? 0) : 0;
436: 
437:       const sum = A - B - C + D;
438:       const area = (x2 - x1 + 1) * (y2 - y1 + 1);
439:       out[y * width + x] = Math.round(sum / area);
440:     }
441:   }
442: 
443:   return out;
444: }
445: 
446: function multiPassBlurGray(
447:   gray: Uint8ClampedArray,
448:   width: number,
449:   height: number,
450:   radius: number,
451:   passes: number
452: ): Uint8ClampedArray {
453:   if (radius <= 0 || passes <= 1) {
454:     return blurGray(gray, width, height, radius);
455:   }
456: 
457:   let input = gray;
458:   let tmp: Uint8ClampedArray = gray;
459: 
460:   for (let p = 0; p < passes; p++) {
461:     tmp = blurGray(input, width, height, radius);
462:     input = tmp;
463:   }
464: 
465:   return tmp;
466: }

5: /**
6:  * A dithering image filter with support for 4 dithering modes and multiple color palettes
7:  * (2-color, 3-color, and multicolor options, using either predefined colors or colors sampled
8:  * from the original image).
9:  *
10:  * SIZING NOTE: This shader performs sizing in the fragment shader (not vertex shader) to keep
11:  * u_pxSize in consistent actual pixels. The pixel grid is computed from gl_FragCoord before any
12:  * transforms, so scaling/rotating only affects the underlying image.
13:  * No vertex shader outputs (v_imageUV, v_objectUV, etc.) are used.
14:  *
15:  * Fragment shader uniforms:
16:  * - u_resolution (vec2): Canvas resolution in pixels
17:  * - u_pixelRatio (float): Device pixel ratio
18:  * - u_originX (float): Reference point for positioning world width in the canvas (0 to 1)
19:  * - u_originY (float): Reference point for positioning world height in the canvas (0 to 1)
20:  * - u_worldWidth (float): Virtual width of the graphic before it's scaled to fit the canvas
21:  * - u_worldHeight (float): Virtual height of the graphic before it's scaled to fit the canvas
22:  * - u_fit (float): How to fit the rendered shader into the canvas dimensions (0 = none, 1 = contain, 2 = cover)
23:  * - u_scale (float): Overall zoom level of the graphics (0.01 to 4)
24:  * - u_rotation (float): Overall rotation angle of the graphics in degrees (0 to 360)
25:  * - u_offsetX (float): Horizontal offset of the graphics center (-1 to 1)
26:  * - u_offsetY (float): Vertical offset of the graphics center (-1 to 1)
27:  * - u_image (sampler2D): Source image texture
28:  * - u_imageAspectRatio (float): Aspect ratio of the source image
29:  * - u_colorFront (vec4): Foreground color in RGBA
30:  * - u_colorBack (vec4): Background color in RGBA
31:  * - u_colorHighlight (vec4): Secondary foreground color in RGBA (set same as colorFront for classic 2-color dithering)
32:  * - u_originalColors (bool): Use the original colors of the image instead of the color palette
33:  * - u_inverted (bool): Inverts the image luminance, doesn't affect the color scheme; not effective at zero contrast
34:  * - u_type (float): Dithering type (1 = random, 2 = 2x2 Bayer, 3 = 4x4 Bayer, 4 = 8x8 Bayer)
35:  * - u_pxSize (float): Pixel size of dithering grid (0.5 to 20)
36:  * - u_colorSteps (float): Number of colors to use, applies to both color modes (1 to 7)
37:  *
38:  */

42: precision mediump float;

76: float getUvFrame(vec2 uv, vec2 pad) {
77:   float aa = 0.0001;

65: vec3 gradientPredefined(float hash) {
66:   int idx = int(hash * 12.0) % 12;

68:   if (idx == 0) return vec3(1, 1, 0);
69:   if (idx == 1) return vec3(-1, 1, 0);
70:   if (idx == 2) return vec3(1, -1, 0);
71:   if (idx == 3) return vec3(-1, -1, 0);
72:   if (idx == 4) return vec3(1, 0, 1);
73:   if (idx == 5) return vec3(-1, 0, 1);
74:   if (idx == 6) return vec3(1, 0, -1);
75:   if (idx == 7) return vec3(-1, 0, -1);
76:   if (idx == 8) return vec3(0, 1, 1);
77:   if (idx == 9) return vec3(0, -1, 1);
78:   if (idx == 10) return vec3(0, 1, -1);
79:   return vec3(0, -1, -1);// idx == 11

82: float interpolateSafe(float v000, float v001, float v010, float v011,
83: float v100, float v101, float v110, float v111, vec3 t) {
84:   t = clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);

86:   float v00 = mix(v000, v100, t.x);
87:   float v01 = mix(v001, v101, t.x);
88:   float v10 = mix(v010, v110, t.x);
89:   float v11 = mix(v011, v111, t.x);
90: 
91:   float v0 = mix(v00, v10, t.y);
92:   float v1 = mix(v01, v11, t.y);
93: 
94:   return mix(v0, v1, t.z);

101: float perlinNoise(vec3 position, float seed) {
102:   position += vec3(seed * 127.1, seed * 311.7, seed * 74.7);

104:   vec3 i = floor(position);
105:   vec3 f = fract(position);

109:   float h011 = hash31(i + vec3(0, 1, 1));
110:   float h100 = hash31(i + vec3(1, 0, 0));
111:   float h101 = hash31(i + vec3(1, 0, 1));
112:   float h110 = hash31(i + vec3(1, 1, 0));
113:   float h111 = hash31(i + vec3(1, 1, 1));

115:   vec3 g001 = gradientPredefined(h001);
116:   vec3 g010 = gradientPredefined(h010);
117:   vec3 g011 = gradientPredefined(h011);

119:   vec3 g101 = gradientPredefined(h101);
120:   vec3 g110 = gradientPredefined(h110);
121:   vec3 g111 = gradientPredefined(h111);
122:   float v000 = dot(g000, f - vec3(0, 0, 0));
123:   float v001 = dot(g001, f - vec3(0, 0, 1));
124:   float v010 = dot(g010, f - vec3(0, 1, 0));
125:   float v011 = dot(g011, f - vec3(0, 1, 1));
126:   float v100 = dot(g100, f - vec3(1, 0, 0));
127:   float v101 = dot(g101, f - vec3(1, 0, 1));
128:   float v110 = dot(g110, f - vec3(1, 1, 0));
129:   float v111 = dot(g111, f - vec3(1, 1, 1));
130: 
131:   vec3 u = fade(f);
132:   return interpolateSafe(v000, v001, v010, v011, v100, v101, v110, v111, u);
133: }

135: float p_noise(vec3 position, int octaveCount, float persistence, float lacunarity) {
136:   float value = 0.0;
137:   float amplitude = 1.0;
138:   float frequency = 10.0;
139:   float maxValue = 0.0;
140:   octaveCount = clamp(octaveCount, 1, 8);
141: 
142:   for (int i = 0; i < octaveCount; i++) {
143:     float seed = float(i) * 0.7319;
144:     value += perlinNoise(position * frequency, seed) * amplitude;
145:     maxValue += amplitude;
146:     amplitude *= persistence;
147:     frequency *= lacunarity;
148:   }
149:   return value;
150: }
151: 
152: float get_max_amp(float persistence, float octaveCount) {
153:   persistence = clamp(persistence * 0.999, 0.0, 0.999);
154:   octaveCount = clamp(octaveCount, 1.0, 8.0);
155: 
156:   if (abs(persistence - 1.0) < 0.001) {
157:     return octaveCount;
158:   }
159: 
160:   return (1.0 - pow(persistence, octaveCount)) / max(1e-4, (1.0 - persistence));
161: }

179:   .5 - .5 * sharpness - smooth_w,
180:   .5 + .5 * sharpness + smooth_w,
181:   noise_normalized
182:   );
183: 
184:   vec3 fgColor = u_colorFront.rgb * u_colorFront.a;
185:   float fgOpacity = u_colorFront.a;
186:   vec3 bgColor = u_colorBack.rgb * u_colorBack.a;
187:   float bgOpacity = u_colorBack.a;

190:   float opacity = fgOpacity * res;
191: 
192:   color += bgColor * (1. - opacity);
193:   opacity += bgOpacity * (1. - opacity);
194: 
195:   ${ colorBandingFix }
196: 
197:   fragColor = vec4(color, opacity);

76: vec4 voronoi(vec2 x, float t) {

152:   float opacity = gradient.a;

154:   ${ colorBandingFix }

156:   fragColor = vec4(color, opacity);

191: float l = max(1e-4, length(shape_uv));

193: float angle = ceil({{bandCount}}) * atan(shape_uv.y, shape_uv.x) + t;
194: float angle_norm = angle / TWO_PI;
195: float twist = 3.0 * clamp({{twist}}, 0.0, 1.0);
196: float offset = pow(l, -twist) + angle_norm;
197: float shape = fract(offset);
198: shape = 1.0 - abs(2.0 * shape - 1.0);
199: shape += {{noiseAmount}} * snoise(15.0 * pow({{noiseFrequency}}, 2.0) * shape_uv);
200: float mid = smoothstep(0.2, 0.2 + 0.8 * {{centerSize}}, pow(l, twist));
201: shape = mix(0.0, shape, mid);
202: float proportion = clamp({{proportion}}, 0.0, 1.0);
203: float exponent = mix(0.25, 1.0, proportion * 2.0);
204: exponent = mix(exponent, 10.0, max(0.0, proportion * 2.0 - 1.0));
205: shape = pow(shape, exponent);
206: float mixer = shape * 3.0;
207: vec3 cols[3];
208: cols[0] = {{color1}};
209: cols[1] = {{color2}};
210: cols[2] = {{color3}};
211: vec3 gradient = cols[0];
212: float outerShape = 0.0;
213: for (int i = 1; i < 4; i++) {
214:   if (i > 3) break;
215:   float m = clamp(mixer - float(i - 1), 0.0, 1.0);
216:   float aa = fwidth(m);
217:   m = smoothstep(0.5 - 0.5 * {{softness}} - aa, 0.5 + 0.5 * {{softness}} + aa, m);
218:   if (i == 1) outerShape = m;
219:   vec3 c = i < 3 ? cols[i] : cols[2];
220:   gradient = mix(gradient, c, m);
221: }
222: float midAA = 0.1 * fwidth(pow(l, -twist));
223: float outerMid = smoothstep(0.2, 0.2 + midAA, pow(l, twist));
224: outerShape = mix(0.0, outerShape, outerMid);
225: vec3 color = gradient * outerShape + {{colorBack}} * (1.0 - outerShape);
226: return vec4(color, 1.0);`,
227:   },
228: })

230: // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
231: // Spiral — animated logarithmic spiral with stroke, distortion, noise.
232: // Direct port of spiral.ts.
233: export const paperSpiralLayer = gen({
234:   id: 'paper-spiral',
235:   name: 'Spiral',
236:   description: 'Paper Shaders spiral — animated logarithmic spiral (faithful port)',
237:   color: '#a855f7',
238:   uniforms: [
239:     { name: 'colorBack', label: 'Background', type: 'vec3', default: [0.02, 0.02, 0.05], ui: { color: true } },
240:     { name: 'colorFront', label: 'Foreground', type: 'vec3', default: [0.95, 0.85, 0.4], ui: { color: true } },
241:     { name: 'density', label: 'Density', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
242:     { name: 'distortion', label: 'Distortion', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
243:     { name: 'strokeWidth', label: 'Stroke Width', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
244:     { name: 'strokeTaper', label: 'Stroke Taper', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
245:     { name: 'strokeCap', label: 'Stroke Cap', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
246:     { name: 'noiseAmount', label: 'Noise', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
247:     { name: 'noiseFrequency', label: 'Noise Freq', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
248:     { name: 'softness', label: 'Softness', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
249:     { name: 'speed', label: 'Speed', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 4, step: 0.05 } },
250:   ],
251:   glsl: {
252:     dependencies: ['snoise'],
253:     functions: `
254: #ifndef TWO_PI
255: #define TWO_PI 6.28318530718
256: #endif
257: #ifndef PI
258: #define PI 3.14159265358979323846
259: #endif`,
260:     main: `
261: ${SCREEN_OBJECT_UV}
262: vec2 spUv = 2.0 * p;
263: float t = u_time * {{speed}};
264: float l = length(spUv);
265: float density = clamp({{density}}, 0.0, 1.0);
266: l = pow(max(l, 1e-6), density);
267: float angle = atan(spUv.y, spUv.x) - t;
268: float angleNormalised = angle / TWO_PI;
269: angleNormalised += 0.125 * {{noiseAmount}} * snoise(16.0 * pow({{noiseFrequency}}, 3.0) * spUv);
270: float offset = l + angleNormalised;
271: offset -= {{distortion}} * (sin(4.0 * l - 0.5 * t) * cos(PI + l + 0.5 * t));
272: float stripe = fract(offset);
273: float shape = 2.0 * abs(stripe - 0.5);
274: float width = 1.0 - clamp({{strokeWidth}}, 0.005 * {{strokeTaper}}, 1.0);
275: float wCap = mix(width, (1.0 - stripe) * (1.0 - step(0.5, stripe)), (1.0 - clamp(l, 0.0, 1.0)));
276: width = mix(width, wCap, {{strokeCap}});
277: width *= (1.0 - clamp({{strokeTaper}}, 0.0, 1.0) * l);
278: float fw = fwidth(offset);
279: float fwMult = 4.0 - 3.0 * (smoothstep(0.05, 0.4, 2.0 * {{strokeWidth}}) * smoothstep(0.05, 0.4, 2.0 * (1.0 - {{strokeWidth}})));
280: float pixelSize = mix(fwMult * fw, fwidth(shape), clamp(fw, 0.0, 1.0));
281: pixelSize = mix(pixelSize, 0.002, {{strokeCap}} * (1.0 - clamp(l, 0.0, 1.0)));
282: float res = smoothstep(width - pixelSize - {{softness}}, width + pixelSize + {{softness}}, shape);
283: vec3 color = mix({{colorBack}}, {{colorFront}}, res);
284: return vec4(color, 1.0);`,
285:   },
286: })
287: 
288: // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
289: // Voronoi (Paper) — IQ two-pass voronoi with cell colors, gap, glow.
290: // Direct port of voronoi.ts. Uses Paper's 256×256 noise texture (bound globally
291: // as `u_noiseTexture`) for cell-center randomization, matching upstream.
292: export const paperVoronoiLayer = gen({
293:   id: 'paper-voronoi',
294:   name: 'Voronoi',
295:   description: 'Paper Shaders voronoi — IQ two-pass with cell colors, gap, glow (faithful port)',
296:   color: '#06b6d4',
297:   uniforms: [
298:     { name: 'color1', label: 'Color 1', type: 'vec3', default: [0.4, 0.7, 1.0], ui: { color: true } },
299:     { name: 'color2', label: 'Color 2', type: 'vec3', default: [0.95, 0.5, 0.7], ui: { color: true } },
300:     { name: 'color3', label: 'Color 3', type: 'vec3', default: [0.3, 0.95, 0.7], ui: { color: true } },
301:     { name: 'colorGap', label: 'Gap', type: 'vec3', default: [0.05, 0.05, 0.08], ui: { color: true } },
302:     { name: 'colorGlow', label: 'Glow', type: 'vec3', default: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], ui: { color: true } },
303:     { name: 'scale', label: 'Scale', type: 'float', default: 5, ui: { min: 0.5, max: 20, step: 0.1 } },
304:     { name: 'distortion', label: 'Distortion', type: 'float', default: 0.25, ui: { min: 0, max: 0.5, step: 0.005 } },
305:     { name: 'gap', label: 'Gap', type: 'float', default: 0.01, ui: { min: 0, max: 0.1, step: 0.001 } },
306:     { name: 'glow', label: 'Glow Amount', type: 'float', default: 0.2, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
307:     { name: 'speed', label: 'Speed', type: 'float', default: 0.4, ui: { min: 0, max: 4, step: 0.05 } },
308:   ],
309:   glsl: {
310:     dependencies: ['noiseTextureRandomGB'],
311:     functions: `
312: #ifndef TWO_PI
313: #define TWO_PI 6.28318530718
314: #endif
315: vec4 paperVoronoi(vec2 x, float t, float distortion) {
316:   vec2 ip = floor(x);
317:   vec2 fp = fract(x);
318:   vec2 mg, mr;
319:   float md = 8.0;
320:   float rand = 0.0;
321:   for (int j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
322:     for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
323:       vec2 g = vec2(float(i), float(j));
324:       vec2 oRaw = noiseTextureRandomGB(ip + g);
325:       vec2 o = 0.5 + distortion * sin(t + TWO_PI * oRaw);
326:       vec2 r = g + o - fp;
327:       float d = dot(r, r);
328:       if (d < md) { md = d; mr = r; mg = g; rand = oRaw.x; }
329:     }
330:   }
331:   md = 8.0;
332:   for (int j = -2; j <= 2; j++) {
333:     for (int i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
334:       vec2 g = mg + vec2(float(i), float(j));
335:       vec2 oRaw = noiseTextureRandomGB(ip + g);
336:       vec2 o = 0.5 + distortion * sin(t + TWO_PI * oRaw);
337:       vec2 r = g + o - fp;
338:       if (dot(mr - r, mr - r) > 1e-5) {
339:         md = min(md, dot(0.5 * (mr + r), normalize(r - mr)));
340:       }
341:     }
342:   }
343:   return vec4(md, mr, rand);
344: }`,
345:     main: `
346: ${SCREEN_OBJECT_UV}
347: vec2 shape_uv = p * {{scale}};
348: float t = u_time * {{speed}};
349: vec4 vRes = paperVoronoi(shape_uv, t, {{distortion}});
350: float shape = clamp(vRes.w, 0.0, 1.0);
351: float mixer = (shape - 0.5 / 3.0) * 3.0;
352: vec3 cols[3];
353: cols[0] = {{color1}};
354: cols[1] = {{color2}};
355: cols[2] = {{color3}};
356: vec3 cellColor = cols[0];
357: for (int i = 1; i < 3; i++) {
358:   float lt = clamp(mixer - float(i - 1), 0.0, 1.0);
359:   cellColor = mix(cellColor, cols[i], lt);
360: }
361: if (mixer < 0.0 || mixer > 2.0) {
362:   float lt = mixer + 1.0;
363:   if (mixer > 2.0) lt = mixer - 2.0;
364:   cellColor = mix(cols[2], cols[0], lt);
365: }
366: float glows = pow(length(vRes.yz * {{glow}}), 1.5);
367: vec3 color = mix(cellColor, {{colorGlow}}, glows);
368: float edge = vRes.x;
369: float smoothEdge = 0.02 * (1.0 + 0.5 * {{gap}});
370: edge = smoothstep({{gap}} - smoothEdge, {{gap}} + smoothEdge, edge);
371: color = mix({{colorGap}}, color, edge);
372: return vec4(color, 1.0);`,
373:   },
374: })
375: 
376: // ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
377: // Simplex Noise (Paper) — two-sample sum mapped through a stepped color ramp.
378: // Distinct from our existing FBM-based `simplex-noise` primitive: this is
379: // Paper's exact algorithm.
380: export const paperSimplexNoiseLayer = gen({
381:   id: 'paper-simplex-noise',
382:   name: 'Simplex Noise',
383:   description: 'Paper Shaders simplex-noise — two-sample sum to ramp (faithful port)',
384:   color: '#8b5cf6',
385:   uniforms: [
386:     { name: 'color1', label: 'Color 1', type: 'vec3', default: [0.0, 0.0, 0.05], ui: { color: true } },
387:     { name: 'color2', label: 'Color 2', type: 'vec3', default: [0.4, 0.6, 1.0], ui: { color: true } },
388:     { name: 'color3', label: 'Color 3', type: 'vec3', default: [1.0, 0.95, 0.85], ui: { color: true } },
389:     { name: 'softness', label: 'Softness', type: 'float', default: 1.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
390:     { name: 'stepsPerColor', label: 'Steps', type: 'float', default: 1, ui: { min: 1, max: 10, step: 1 } },
391:     { name: 'speed', label: 'Speed', type: 'float', default: 1, ui: { min: 0, max: 4, step: 0.05 } },
392:   ],
393:   glsl: {
394:     dependencies: ['snoise'],
395:     functions: `
396: float steppedSmooth(float m, float steps, float softness) {
397:   float stepT = floor(m * steps) / steps;
398:   float f = m * steps - floor(m * steps);
399:   float fw = steps * fwidth(m);
400:   float smoothed = smoothstep(0.5 - softness, min(1.0, 0.5 + softness + fw), f);
401:   return stepT + smoothed / steps;
402: }`,
403:     main: `
404: ${SCREEN_OBJECT_UV}
405: vec2 shape_uv = p * 0.1 * 10.0;
406: float t = 0.2 * u_time * {{speed}};
407: float n = 0.5 * snoise(shape_uv - vec2(0.0, 0.3 * t));
408: n += 0.5 * snoise(2.0 * shape_uv + vec2(0.0, 0.32 * t));
409: float shape = 0.5 + 0.5 * n;
410: float mixer = (shape - 0.5 / 3.0) * 3.0;
411: float steps = max(1.0, {{stepsPerColor}});
412: vec3 cols[3];
413: cols[0] = {{color1}};
414: cols[1] = {{color2}};
415: cols[2] = {{color3}};
416: vec3 gradient = cols[0];
417: for (int i = 1; i < 3; i++) {
418:   float localM = clamp(mixer - float(i - 1), 0.0, 1.0);
419:   localM = steppedSmooth(localM, steps, 0.5 * {{softness}});
420:   gradient = mix(gradient, cols[i], localM);
421: }
422: if (mixer < 0.0 || mixer > 2.0) {
423:   float localM = mixer + 1.0;
424:   if (mixer > 2.0) localM = mixer - 2.0;
425:   localM = steppedSmooth(localM, steps, 0.5 * {{softness}});
426:   gradient = mix(cols[2], cols[0], localM);
427: }
428: return vec4(gradient, 1.0);`,
429:   },
430: })

340: // CMYK channel separation. Output mode 0 = grayscale (channel as luma);
341: // mode 1 = tinted (full CMYK process color). Stack four with mode=1 +
342: // halftone effects for a CMYK halftone print look.
343: export const cmykSeparateLayer = sampleFx({
344:   id: 'cmyk-separate',
345:   name: 'CMYK Separate',
346:   description: 'Output a single CMYK channel from previous pass',
347:   color: '#f59e0b',
348:   uniforms: [
349:     {
350:       name: 'channel',
351:       label: 'Channel',
352:       type: 'int',
353:       default: 0,
354:       ui: { min: 0, max: 3, step: 1 },
355:     },
356:     {
357:       name: 'mode',
358:       label: 'Mode',
359:       type: 'int',
360:       default: 0,
361:       ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 1 },
362:     },
363:   ],
364:   glsl: {
365:     main: `
366: vec3 rgb = texture(u_prevPass, uv).rgb;
367: float k = 1.0 - max(rgb.r, max(rgb.g, rgb.b));
368: vec4 cmyk = vec4(0.0);
369: float denom = max(1.0 - k, 1e-4);
370: cmyk.x = (1.0 - rgb.r - k) / denom; // C
371: cmyk.y = (1.0 - rgb.g - k) / denom; // M
372: cmyk.z = (1.0 - rgb.b - k) / denom; // Y
373: cmyk.w = k;
374: int ch = {{channel}};
375: float v = ch == 0 ? cmyk.x : ch == 1 ? cmyk.y : ch == 2 ? cmyk.z : cmyk.w;
376: v = clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0);
377: if ({{mode}} == 0) return vec4(v, v, v, 1.0);
378: vec3 tints[4];
379: tints[0] = vec3(0.0, 0.7, 0.95); // C
380: tints[1] = vec3(0.95, 0.1, 0.5); // M
381: tints[2] = vec3(0.95, 0.85, 0.1); // Y
382: tints[3] = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);   // K
383: vec3 tint = tints[0];
384: if (ch == 1) tint = tints[1];
385: else if (ch == 2) tint = tints[2];
386: else if (ch == 3) tint = tints[3];
387: return vec4(mix(vec3(1.0), tint, v), 1.0);`,
388:   },

393: export const imageEdgeLayer = sampleFx({
394:   id: 'image-edge',
395:   name: 'Image Edge',
396:   description: 'Sobel edge detection — use after an image or gradient source',
397:   color: '#f59e0b',
398:   uniforms: [
399:     { name: 'thickness', label: 'Thickness', type: 'float', default: 1.0, ui: { min: 0.1, max: 8, step: 0.1 } },
400:     { name: 'intensity', label: 'Intensity', type: 'float', default: 1.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 4, step: 0.05 } },
401:     { name: 'smooth', label: 'Smooth', type: 'float', default: 0.1, ui: { min: 0, max: 0.5, step: 0.01 } },
402:   ],
403:   glsl: {
404:     dependencies: ['luma'],
405:     main: `
406: vec2 texel = 1.0 / u_resolution * {{thickness}};
407: float tl = luma(texture(u_prevPass, uv + vec2(-texel.x, -texel.y)).rgb);
408: float tc = luma(texture(u_prevPass, uv + vec2(0.0,     -texel.y)).rgb);
409: float tr = luma(texture(u_prevPass, uv + vec2( texel.x, -texel.y)).rgb);
410: float ml = luma(texture(u_prevPass, uv + vec2(-texel.x,  0.0    )).rgb);
411: float mr = luma(texture(u_prevPass, uv + vec2( texel.x,  0.0    )).rgb);
412: float bl = luma(texture(u_prevPass, uv + vec2(-texel.x,  texel.y)).rgb);
413: float bc = luma(texture(u_prevPass, uv + vec2(0.0,      texel.y)).rgb);
414: float br = luma(texture(u_prevPass, uv + vec2( texel.x,  texel.y)).rgb);
415: float gx = -tl - 2.0 * ml - bl + tr + 2.0 * mr + br;
416: float gy = -tl - 2.0 * tc - tr + bl + 2.0 * bc + br;
417: float edge = clamp(length(vec2(gx, gy)) * {{intensity}}, 0.0, 1.0);
418: edge = smoothstep({{smooth}}, {{smooth}} + 0.1, edge);
419: return vec4(edge, edge, edge, 1.0);`,
420:   },

185: // Material Noise — layered paper/fiber/crumple/grain texture generator.
186: // Use as a source with overlay/multiply blend on top of an image or gradient.
187: // Faithfully models Paper's paper-texture primitive breakdown.
188: export const materialNoiseLayer = baseFx({
189:   id: 'material-noise',
190:   name: 'Material Noise',
191:   description: 'Layered fiber, crumple, fold, and grain texture — use with Multiply/Overlay blend',
192:   color: '#fef3c7',
193:   uniforms: [
194:     { name: 'colorFront', label: 'Dark Fiber', type: 'vec3', default: [0.62, 0.68, 0.74], ui: { color: true } },
195:     { name: 'colorBack', label: 'Base', type: 'vec3', default: [1.0, 1.0, 1.0], ui: { color: true } },
196:     { name: 'fiber', label: 'Fiber', type: 'float', default: 0.3, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
197:     { name: 'fiberScale', label: 'Fiber Scale', type: 'float', default: 60.0, ui: { min: 4, max: 300, step: 1 } },
198:     { name: 'fiberAngle', label: 'Fiber Angle', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 360, step: 1 } },
199:     { name: 'crumples', label: 'Crumples', type: 'float', default: 0.2, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
200:     { name: 'crumpleScale', label: 'Crumple Scale', type: 'float', default: 40.0, ui: { min: 2, max: 200, step: 1 } },
201:     { name: 'grain', label: 'Grain', type: 'float', default: 0.08, ui: { min: 0, max: 0.5, step: 0.005 } },
202:     { name: 'contrast', label: 'Contrast', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
203:   ],
204:   glsl: {
205:     dependencies: ['simplex2D', 'rotate2D', 'hash'],
206:     main: `
207: // Fiber layer — directional high-frequency noise
208: vec2 fq = rotate2D(uv * {{fiberScale}}, {{fiberAngle}} * 3.14159 / 180.0);
209: float fiberN = simplex2D(fq) * 0.5 + simplex2D(fq * 3.1) * 0.25 + simplex2D(fq * 7.3) * 0.125;
210: fiberN = fiberN * 0.5 + 0.5;
211: // Crumple layer — low-frequency large folds
212: vec2 cq = uv * {{crumpleScale}};
213: float crumpleN = abs(simplex2D(cq) * 0.6 + simplex2D(cq * 2.3) * 0.3 + simplex2D(cq * 5.1) * 0.1);
214: crumpleN = 1.0 - crumpleN;
215: // Grain layer
216: float grainN = hash(uv * u_resolution + fract(u_time)) * 2.0 - 1.0;
217: // Composite
218: float v = mix(0.5, fiberN, {{fiber}});
219: v = mix(v, v * crumpleN, {{crumples}});
220: v = clamp(v + grainN * {{grain}}, 0.0, 1.0);
221: // Contrast
222: v = (v - 0.5) * (1.0 + {{contrast}}) + 0.5;
223: v = clamp(v, 0.0, 1.0);
224: vec3 col = mix({{colorFront}}, {{colorBack}}, v);
225: return vec4(col, 1.0);`,
226:   },
227: })

229: // Dot Glyph Grid — faithful Paper dot-grid recreation: regular lattice of
230: // geometric dots with per-dot random size/opacity, multiple shapes.
231: export const dotGlyphGridLayer = baseFx({
232:   id: 'dot-glyph-grid',
233:   name: 'Dot Glyph Grid',
234:   description: 'Regular grid of geometric dots — circle, square, diamond, or cross',
235:   color: '#475569',
236:   uniforms: [
237:     { name: 'colorBack', label: 'Background', type: 'vec3', default: [0.05, 0.05, 0.08], ui: { color: true } },
238:     { name: 'colorFill', label: 'Fill', type: 'vec3', default: [0.95, 0.9, 0.7], ui: { color: true } },
239:     { name: 'colorStroke', label: 'Stroke', type: 'vec3', default: [1.0, 0.7, 0.3], ui: { color: true } },
240:     { name: 'gapX', label: 'Gap X', type: 'float', default: 30.0, ui: { min: 4, max: 200, step: 1 } },
241:     { name: 'gapY', label: 'Gap Y', type: 'float', default: 30.0, ui: { min: 4, max: 200, step: 1 } },
242:     { name: 'dotSize', label: 'Dot Size', type: 'float', default: 0.3, ui: { min: 0.05, max: 0.95, step: 0.01 } },
243:     { name: 'strokeWidth', label: 'Stroke', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 0.2, step: 0.005 } },
244:     { name: 'sizeRange', label: 'Size Rand', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 0.5, step: 0.01 } },
245:     { name: 'opacityRange', label: 'Opacity Rand', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
246:     { name: 'shape', label: 'Shape (0=circle 1=sq 2=diamond 3=cross)', type: 'int', default: 0, ui: { min: 0, max: 3, step: 1 } },
247:   ],
248:   glsl: {
249:     dependencies: ['hash21'],
250:     main: `
251: vec2 _ar = vec2(u_resolution.x / max(u_resolution.y, 1.0), 1.0);
252: // Grid coords in pixel space
253: vec2 px = uv * u_resolution;
254: vec2 cellSize = vec2({{gapX}}, {{gapY}});
255: vec2 cellId = floor(px / cellSize);
256: vec2 cellUv = (px - cellId * cellSize) / cellSize - 0.5;
257: // Per-cell random
258: float rnd = hash21(cellId);
259: float sz = {{dotSize}} + (rnd - 0.5) * {{sizeRange}};
260: sz = clamp(sz, 0.01, 0.99);
261: float opRand = 1.0 - rnd * {{opacityRange}};
262: // Aspect-correct the cell UV
263: cellUv.x *= cellSize.x / cellSize.y;
264: // SDF by shape
265: float d;
266: int sh = {{shape}};
267: if (sh == 1) {
268:   // square
269:   vec2 q = abs(cellUv);
270:   d = max(q.x, q.y) - sz * 0.5;
271: } else if (sh == 2) {
272:   // diamond
273:   d = (abs(cellUv.x) + abs(cellUv.y)) - sz * 0.5;
274: } else if (sh == 3) {
275:   // cross
276:   float arm = sz * 0.15;
277:   float len = sz * 0.5;
278:   float h = max(abs(cellUv.x) - len, abs(cellUv.y) - arm);
279:   float v2 = max(abs(cellUv.y) - len, abs(cellUv.x) - arm);
280:   d = min(h, v2);
281: } else {
282:   // circle (default)
283:   d = length(cellUv) - sz * 0.5;
284: }
285: float aa = fwidth(d);
286: float fill = 1.0 - smoothstep(-aa, aa, d);
287: float stroke = smoothstep(-({{strokeWidth}} + aa), -({{strokeWidth}} - aa), d) * fill;
288: vec3 col = {{colorBack}};
289: col = mix(col, {{colorFill}}, fill * opRand);
290: col = mix(col, {{colorStroke}}, stroke * opRand);
291: return vec4(col, 1.0);`,
292:   },
293: })

322: const float HC_SIN_K = 0.7071068;
323: float hcDotMask(vec2 uv, vec2 cellOffset, float cov, float softness) {
324:   vec2 cellCenter = floor(uv) + 0.5 + cellOffset;
325:   vec2 pos = uv;

327:   float radius = clamp(cov, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.55;
328:   float mask = 1.0 - smoothstep(radius * (1.0 - softness * 0.5), radius + softness * 0.05 + 1e-4, d);

331: float hcAccum(vec2 uv, float cov, float softness) {
332:   float m = 0.0;
333:   for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {

351: vec2 uvY = grid + 0.2;

353: float maskC = hcAccum(uvC, cmy.x * src.a, {{softness}});
354: float maskM = hcAccum(uvM, cmy.y * src.a, {{softness}});
355: float maskY = hcAccum(uvY, cmy.z * src.a, {{softness}});
356: float maskK = hcAccum(uvK, k * src.a, {{softness}});
357: // Subtractive ink: paper * (1 - cov*(1-inkColor))
358: vec3 paper = {{colorBack}};

334: const float CP_Z_LIMIT = 0.5;
335: 
336: vec2 cpGetPanel(float angle, vec2 uv, float invLength, float aa, float blur, float a1, float a2, bool edges) {
337:   float sinA = sin(angle);
338:   float cosA = cos(angle);
339:   float denom = sinA - uv.y * cosA;
340:   if (abs(denom) < 0.01) return vec2(0.0);
341:   float z = uv.y / denom;
342:   if (z <= 0.0 || z > CP_Z_LIMIT) return vec2(0.0);
343:   float zRatio = z / CP_Z_LIMIT;
344:   float panelMap = 1.0 - zRatio;
345:   float x = uv.x * (cosA * z + 1.0) * invLength;
346:   float zOff = zRatio - 0.5;
347:   float left = -0.5 + zOff * a1;
348:   float right = 0.5 - zOff * a2;
349:   float blurX = aa + 2.0 * panelMap * blur;
350:   float panel = smoothstep(left - blurX, left + 0.25 * blurX, x)
351:               * (1.0 - smoothstep(right - 0.25 * blurX, right + blurX, x));
352:   panel *= mix(0.0, panel, smoothstep(0.0, 0.01, panelMap));
353:   float midScreen = abs(sinA);
354:   if (edges) {
355:     panelMap = mix(0.99, panelMap, panel * clamp(panelMap / (0.15 * (1.0 - pow(midScreen, 0.1))), 0.0, 1.0));
356:   } else if (midScreen < 0.07) {
357:     panel *= midScreen * 15.0;
358:   }
359:   return vec2(panel, panelMap);
360: }

522: // Alpha Falloff — replicates Paper's heatmap pre-processing in-shader by
523: // reading (1 - alpha) at THREE Gaussian-equivalent blur scales (sharp / mid
524: // / wide). Uses the hardware mipmap chain via textureLod() — the runtime
525: // generates mipmaps for FBO render targets after each pass, so reading
526: // LOD = log2(radius * texSize) gives us a perfectly filtered wide blur with
527: // zero aliasing (vs manual Vogel-disc taps which reveal discrete sample
528: // rings at large radii). (1 - alpha) is the analog of Paper's "luma of
529: // black-on-white-fill" preprocessing input. Outputs:
530: //   .r = shape  — sharp blur of (1-alpha): ~0 inside silhouette, ~1 outside,
531: //                 sharp ramp at edge. Used as Paper's inside/outside mask.
532: //   .g = big    — wide blur of (1-alpha): slow ramp from 0 inside to 1 outside.
533: //                 Used to derive both inner glow (peaks just inside edge) and
534: //                 outer aura (peaks just outside edge).
535: //   .b = inner  — mid blur of (1-alpha): drives the bright contour line that
536: //                 hugs the silhouette edge.
537: //   .a = original alpha (preserved for downstream compositing)
538: // Pair after `image-source` to drive heatmap-style auras or any effect that
539: // needs Paper's three-scale silhouette decomposition.
540: export const alphaFalloffLayer = sampleFx({
541:   id: 'alpha-falloff',
542:   name: 'Alpha Falloff',
543:   description: "Three-scale silhouette decomposition — Paper heatmap's preprocessing in-shader",
544:   color: '#f59e0b',
545:   uniforms: [
546:     { name: 'sharpRadius', label: 'Sharp Radius', type: 'float', default: 0.012, ui: { min: 0.001, max: 0.05, step: 0.001 } },
547:     { name: 'midRadius', label: 'Mid Radius', type: 'float', default: 0.04, ui: { min: 0.005, max: 0.1, step: 0.001 } },
548:     { name: 'wideRadius', label: 'Wide Radius', type: 'float', default: 0.16, ui: { min: 0.02, max: 0.5, step: 0.005 } },
549:   ],
550:   glsl: {
551:     functions: `
552: // Aspect-corrected circular blur of (1 - alpha) — pyramid-style sampling.
553: //
554: // A single textureGrad call with footprint = wide radius would sample mip
555: // levels so coarse (e.g. LOD 6.4 on a 768×540 FBO is mip 6×4, ~24 unique
556: // values across the canvas) that the GPU's bilinear interpolation reveals
557: // individual mip texels as visible rectangular patches. Instead, we sum a
558: // Vogel disc of textureGrad samples, each with a per-tap footprint that's
559: // only a fraction of the total radius. Per-tap LOD ends up around 3-4 where
560: // there's plenty of detail. Tap count scales with radius so the inter-tap
561: // spacing never exceeds one per-tap footprint; without this, fixed N=8 taps
562: // would leave large radii (e.g. 614 px on a 4K FBO) with 217 px between
563: // samples — visibly jagged silhouettes.
564: float afOneMinusAlphaCircular(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, float radiusUV, vec2 dim) {
565:   float minDim = min(dim.x, dim.y);
566:   float rPx = max(radiusUV * minDim, 1.0);
567:   int N = int(clamp(rPx / 8.0, 8.0, 64.0));
568:   float perTapPx = max(rPx * 0.33, 1.0);
569:   vec2 ddx = vec2(perTapPx / dim.x, 0.0);
570:   vec2 ddy = vec2(0.0, perTapPx / dim.y);
571:   vec2 pxToUv = 1.0 / dim;
572:   float sum = 1.0 - textureGrad(src, uv, ddx, ddy).a;
573:   float total = 1.0;
574:   const int MAX_TAPS = 64;
575:   for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TAPS; i++) {
576:     if (i >= N) break;
577:     float fi = float(i) + 0.5;
578:     float ang = fi * 2.39996323;
579:     float r01 = sqrt(fi / float(N));
580:     float w = exp(-r01 * r01 * 1.5);
581:     vec2 dirPx = vec2(cos(ang), sin(ang)) * r01 * rPx;
582:     vec2 dirUV = dirPx * pxToUv;
583:     sum += w * (1.0 - textureGrad(src, uv + dirUV, ddx, ddy).a);
584:     total += w;
585:   }
586:   return sum / total;
587: }`,
588:     main: `
589: vec2 dim = vec2(textureSize(u_prevPass, 0));
590: float aSharp = afOneMinusAlphaCircular(u_prevPass, uv, {{sharpRadius}}, dim);
591: float aMid = afOneMinusAlphaCircular(u_prevPass, uv, {{midRadius}}, dim);
592: float aWide = afOneMinusAlphaCircular(u_prevPass, uv, {{wideRadius}}, dim);
593: float origAlpha = texture(u_prevPass, uv).a;
594: return vec4(aSharp, aWide, aMid, origAlpha);`,
595:   },
596:   outputKind: 'scalar',
597: })

599: // Heat Pulse — faithful port of Paper's heatmap inner/outer/contour math.
600: // Reads the three blur scales from `alpha-falloff` (.r=shape, .g=big,
601: // .b=inner) and applies Paper's exact algorithm:
602: //   - outerBlur = shape * (1 - big)        peaks just outside the silhouette
603: //   - innerBlur = (1 - shape) * big        peaks just inside the silhouette
604: //   - contour   = (1 - shape) * inner      bright edge line just inside
605: //   - 3 phase-offset shadow shapes subtract from inner over time
606: //   - rotating outer wave amplifies a moving slice of the outer aura
607: //   - heat = inner + outer (additive, clamped 0..1)
608: // Output is a single-channel heat scalar in [0, 1] for `color-ramp` to colour.
609: export const heatPulseLayer = sampleFx({

612:   description: "Paper heatmap inner/outer/contour algorithm — pair after alpha-falloff",
613:   color: '#f97316',
614:   uniforms: [
615:     { name: 'innerGlow', label: 'Inner Glow', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
616:     { name: 'outerGlow', label: 'Outer Glow', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
617:     { name: 'contour', label: 'Contour', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
618:     { name: 'angle', label: 'Wave Angle', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 360, step: 1 } },
619:     { name: 'speed', label: 'Speed', type: 'float', default: 1.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 4, step: 0.05 } },
620:   ],
621:   glsl: {
622:     dependencies: ['rotate2D'],
623:     functions: `
624: // Generic analog of Paper's apple-specific shadowShape: a drifting circle
625: // that travels top-to-bottom over the cycle, with vertical scale animation
626: // and a "flat top" blend in the upper portion of its travel. This produces
627: // large, slowly-evolving dark patches that move through the silhouette so
628: // three phase-offset copies almost always cover most of the silhouette.
629: float hpShadowShape(vec2 uv, float t, float innerGlowField) {
630:   float posY = mix(-1.0, 2.0, t);
631:   vec2 p = uv;
632:   p.y -= 0.5;
633:   float mainCircleScale = smoothstep(0.0, 0.8, posY) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.9, 1.4, posY));
634:   p *= vec2(1.0, 1.0 + 1.5 * mainCircleScale);
635:   p.y += 0.5;
636:   // Travelling main circle (Paper's primary shadow disc)
637:   float innerR = 0.4;
638:   float outerR = 1.0 - 0.3 * (smoothstep(0.1, 0.2, t) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.2, 0.5, t)));
639:   vec2 c = vec2(0.5, posY - 0.2);
640:   vec2 d = p - c;
641:   float r = length(d);
642:   float s = 1.0 - smoothstep(innerR, outerR, r);
643:   s = pow(s, 1.4) * 1.2;
644:   // Top-flatten blend during early travel (matches Paper's topFlattener)
645:   float pos = posY - uv.y;
646:   float topFlat = clamp(smoothstep(-0.4, 0.0, pos) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, pos)), 0.0, 1.0);
647:   topFlat = pow(topFlat, 3.0);
648:   float topMixer = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 0.3, pos);
649:   s = mix(topFlat, s, topMixer);
650:   return clamp(s, 0.0, 1.0);
651: }`,
652:     main: `
653: vec4 src = texture(u_prevPass, uv);
654: float shape = src.r;
655: float big = src.g;
656: float innerCh = src.b;
657: 
658: // Paper's inner/outer/contour decomposition.
659: float outerBlur = shape * (1.0 - big);
660: float innerBlur = (1.0 - shape) * big;
661: float contour = (1.0 - shape) * innerCh;
662: 
663: // Animated time with three phase-offset copies (Paper: t, t+1/3, t+2/3).
664: float t = u_time * {{speed}} * 0.1 - 0.3;
665: float t0 = fract(t);
666: float t1 = fract(t + 1.0/3.0);
667: float t2 = fract(t + 2.0/3.0);
668: 
669: // Rotate UV so the wave/shadow travel direction is configurable.
670: float ang = -{{angle}} * 3.14159 / 180.0;
671: vec2 animUV = rotate2D(uv - 0.5, ang) + 0.5;
672: 
673: float shadow0 = hpShadowShape(animUV, t0, innerBlur);
674: float shadow1 = hpShadowShape(animUV, t1, innerBlur);
675: float shadow2 = hpShadowShape(animUV, t2, innerBlur);
676: 
677: // Inner: baseline interior brightness, dimmed by passing shadow shapes,
678: // then masked to inside via (1 - shape).
679: float inner = 0.8 + 0.8 * innerBlur;
680: inner = mix(inner, 0.0, shadow0);
681: inner = mix(inner, 0.0, shadow1);
682: inner = mix(inner, 0.0, shadow2);
683: inner *= mix(0.0, 2.0, {{innerGlow}});
684: inner += ({{contour}} * 2.0) * contour;
685: inner = min(1.0, inner);
686: inner *= (1.0 - shape);
687: inner = pow(inner, 1.2);
688: 
689: // Outer: animated wave band sweeping across in the rotated y direction,
690: // multiplied by the silhouette's outer halo (peaks just outside the edge).
691: float t3 = fract(t * 3.0 - 0.1);
692: float ty = fract(animUV.y - t3);
693: float animatedMask = smoothstep(0.3, 0.65, ty) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.65, 1.0, ty));
694: animatedMask = 0.5 + animatedMask;
695: float outer = 0.9 * pow(outerBlur, 0.8);
696: outer *= animatedMask;
697: outer *= mix(0.0, 5.0, pow({{outerGlow}}, 2.0));
698: 
699: float heat = clamp(inner + outer, 0.0, 1.0);
700: return vec4(heat, heat, heat, 1.0);`,
701:   },
702:   outputKind: 'scalar',

538: // Chrome Wave — Paper liquid-metal port. Generates the animated multi-band
539: // chrome stripe profile across the previous pass's silhouette, complete with
540: // Paper's interior-gradient bump modulation, simplex surface noise, per-stripe
541: // width modulation by bump, RGB chromatic dispersion, and edge-aware blur.
542: //
543: // The interior gradient (Paper's Poisson-solved img.r) is approximated by a
544: // 16-tap Vogel-disc wide blur of prevPass.alpha — this gives the smooth
545: // distance-from-edge field that drives stripe pinching and refraction.
546: //
547: // Pair after `image-source` for true liquid-metal-on-logo, or after any
548: // generator that fills its alpha channel (shapes, metaballs, etc.).
549: export const chromeWaveLayer = distorter({
550:   id: 'chrome-wave',
551:   name: 'Chrome Wave',
552:   description: 'Paper liquid-metal chrome stripe — pair after image-source',
553:   color: '#94a3b8',
554:   uniforms: [
555:     { name: 'colorBack', label: 'Background', type: 'vec4', default: [0.95, 0.95, 0.97, 1.0], ui: { color: true } },
556:     { name: 'colorChrome1', label: 'Chrome Light', type: 'vec3', default: [0.98, 0.98, 1.0], ui: { color: true } },
557:     { name: 'colorChrome2', label: 'Chrome Dark', type: 'vec3', default: [0.1, 0.1, 0.12], ui: { color: true } },
558:     { name: 'colorTint', label: 'Tint', type: 'vec4', default: [0.5, 0.6, 1.0, 0.0], ui: { color: true } },
559:     { name: 'angle', label: 'Angle', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 360, step: 1 } },
560:     { name: 'repetition', label: 'Repetition', type: 'float', default: 4, ui: { min: 1, max: 10, step: 0.1 } },
561:     { name: 'softness', label: 'Softness', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
562:     { name: 'shiftRed', label: 'Shift Red', type: 'float', default: 0.3, ui: { min: -1, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
563:     { name: 'shiftBlue', label: 'Shift Blue', type: 'float', default: -0.3, ui: { min: -1, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
564:     { name: 'distortion', label: 'Distortion', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
565:     { name: 'contour', label: 'Contour', type: 'float', default: 0.4, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
566:     { name: 'edgeRadius', label: 'Edge Radius', type: 'float', default: 0.22, ui: { min: 0.02, max: 0.5, step: 0.005 } },
567:     { name: 'speed', label: 'Speed', type: 'float', default: 0.3, ui: { min: 0, max: 4, step: 0.05 } },
568:   ],
569:   glsl: {
570:     dependencies: ['rotate2D', 'simplex2D'],
571:     functions: `
572: // Paper's per-channel multi-band stripe profile. Each stripe period contains:
573: // gradient-rise → thin shadow band → thin highlight band → wide gradient.
574: // 'bump' modulates band positions so highlights bunch toward shape interior.
575: float cwGetColorChanges(float c1, float c2, float p, vec3 w, float blur, float bump) {
576:   bump = smoothstep(0.2, 0.8, bump);
577:   float ch = mix(c2, c1, smoothstep(0.0, 2.0 * blur, p));
578:   float border = w.x;
579:   ch = mix(ch, c2, smoothstep(border, border + 2.0 * blur, p));
580:   border = w.x + 0.4 * (1.0 - bump) * w.y;
581:   ch = mix(ch, c1, smoothstep(border, border + 2.0 * blur, p));
582:   border = w.x + 0.5 * (1.0 - bump) * w.y;
583:   ch = mix(ch, c2, smoothstep(border, border + 2.0 * blur, p));
584:   border = w.x + w.y;
585:   ch = mix(ch, c1, smoothstep(border, border + 2.0 * blur, p));
586:   float gradT = (p - w.x - w.y) / max(w.z, 1e-4);
587:   float gradient = mix(c1, c2, smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, gradT));
588:   ch = mix(ch, gradient, smoothstep(border, border + 0.5 * blur, p));
589:   return ch;
590: }
591: // Vogel-disc Gaussian blur of alpha — approximates Paper's Poisson interior
592: // gradient (high at shape centre, low at edges + outside). Each tap uses
593: // textureGrad with a per-tap footprint so the GPU's mip-filtering hides
594: // individual sample positions; tap count scales with radius so the inter-tap
595: // spacing never exceeds one per-tap footprint, killing the ringed/jagged
596: // silhouette artifacts a fixed N=16 produced at large radii.
597: float cwWideAlpha(sampler2D src, vec2 uv, float radius) {
598:   vec2 dim = vec2(textureSize(src, 0));
599:   float minDim = min(dim.x, dim.y);
600:   float rPx = max(radius * minDim, 1.0);
601:   int N = int(clamp(rPx / 8.0, 8.0, 64.0));
602:   float perTapPx = max(rPx * 0.33, 1.0);
603:   vec2 ddx = vec2(perTapPx / dim.x, 0.0);
604:   vec2 ddy = vec2(0.0, perTapPx / dim.y);
605:   vec2 pxToUv = 1.0 / dim;
606:   float sum = textureGrad(src, uv, ddx, ddy).a;
607:   float total = 1.0;
608:   const int MAX_TAPS = 64;
609:   for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TAPS; i++) {
610:     if (i >= N) break;
611:     float fi = float(i) + 0.5;
612:     float ang = fi * 2.39996323;
613:     float r01 = sqrt(fi / float(N));
614:     float w = exp(-r01 * r01 * 1.5);
615:     vec2 dirPx = vec2(cos(ang), sin(ang)) * r01 * rPx;
616:     vec2 dirUV = dirPx * pxToUv;
617:     sum += w * textureGrad(src, uv + dirUV, ddx, ddy).a;
618:     total += w;
619:   }
620:   return sum / total;
621: }`,
622:     main: `
623: const float firstFrameOffset = 2.8;
624: float t = {{speed}} * (u_time + firstFrameOffset);
625: 
626: vec4 src = texture(u_prevPass, uv);
627: float opacity = src.a;
628: // Interior gradient — wide-blur of alpha approximates Paper's Poisson solve.
629: float edgeRaw = cwWideAlpha(u_prevPass, uv, {{edgeRadius}});
630: float edge = pow(edgeRaw, 1.6);
631: edge *= mix(0.0, 1.0, smoothstep(0.0, 0.4, {{contour}}));
632: 
633: // Rotated UV for stripe direction
634: float angle = (-{{angle}} + 70.0) * 3.14159 / 180.0;
635: vec2 rotatedUV = rotate2D(uv - 0.5, angle) + 0.5;
636: float diagBLtoTR = rotatedUV.x - rotatedUV.y;
637: float diagTLtoBR = rotatedUV.x + rotatedUV.y;
638: 
639: // Bump (Paper's interior dome) — radial falloff biased by diagonal axis,
640: // then biased toward top of frame (heavier highlights up top).
641: vec2 grad_uv = uv - 0.5;
642: float dist = length(grad_uv + vec2(0.0, 0.2 * diagBLtoTR));
643: grad_uv = rotate2D(grad_uv, (0.25 - 0.2 * diagBLtoTR) * 3.14159);
644: float direction = grad_uv.x;
645: float bump = pow(1.8 * dist, 1.2);
646: bump = 1.0 - bump;
647: bump *= pow(uv.y, 0.3);
648: 
649: // Stripe widths (modulated by bump so highlights compress at shape interior)
650: float cycleWidth = max({{repetition}}, 0.5);
651: float thin1Ratio = 0.12 / cycleWidth * (1.0 - 0.4 * bump);
652: float thin2Ratio = 0.07 / cycleWidth * (1.0 + 0.4 * bump);
653: float wideRatio = 1.0 - thin1Ratio - thin2Ratio;
654: float thin1Width = cycleWidth * thin1Ratio;
655: float thin2Width = cycleWidth * thin2Ratio;
656: 
657: // Surface simplex noise — drives both stripe distortion + edge perturbation
658: float n = simplex2D(uv - t);
659: edge += (1.0 - edge) * {{distortion}} * n;
660: 
661: // Paper's direction modulation — this is what makes stripes refract through
662: // the shape edges and pinch around the interior bump.
663: direction += diagBLtoTR;
664: direction -= 2.0 * n * diagBLtoTR * (smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, edge) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, edge)));
665: direction *= mix(1.0, 1.0 - edge, smoothstep(0.5, 1.0, {{contour}}));
666: direction -= 1.7 * edge * smoothstep(0.5, 1.0, {{contour}});
667: direction += 0.2 * pow({{contour}}, 4.0) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, edge));
668: 
669: bump *= clamp(pow(uv.y, 0.1), 0.3, 1.0);
670: direction *= (0.1 + (1.1 - edge) * bump);
671: direction *= (0.4 + 0.6 * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.5, 1.0, edge)));
672: direction += 0.18 * (smoothstep(0.1, 0.2, uv.y) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.2, 0.4, uv.y)));
673: direction += 0.03 * (smoothstep(0.1, 0.2, 1.0 - uv.y) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.2, 0.4, 1.0 - uv.y)));
674: direction *= (0.5 + 0.5 * pow(uv.y, 2.0));
675: direction *= cycleWidth;
676: direction -= t;
677: 
678: // Per-channel chromatic dispersion
679: float colorDispersion = clamp(1.0 - bump, 0.0, 1.0);
680: float dispersionRed = colorDispersion + 0.03 * bump * n;
681: dispersionRed += 5.0 * (smoothstep(-0.1, 0.2, uv.y) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.1, 0.5, uv.y))) * (smoothstep(0.4, 0.6, bump) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.4, 1.0, bump)));
682: dispersionRed -= diagBLtoTR;
683: float dispersionBlue = colorDispersion * 1.3;
684: dispersionBlue += (smoothstep(0.0, 0.4, uv.y) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.1, 0.8, uv.y))) * (smoothstep(0.4, 0.6, bump) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.4, 0.8, bump)));
685: dispersionBlue -= 0.2 * edge;
686: dispersionRed *= ({{shiftRed}} / 20.0);
687: dispersionBlue *= ({{shiftBlue}} / 20.0);
688: 
689: // Edge-aware per-channel blur: softer near shape edges, sharper at interior
690: float softness = 0.05 * {{softness}};
691: float blur = softness + 0.5 * smoothstep(1.0, 10.0, {{repetition}}) * smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, edge);
692: float smallCanvasT = 1.0 - smoothstep(100.0, 500.0, min(u_resolution.x, u_resolution.y));
693: blur += smallCanvasT * smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, edge);
694: float rExtraBlur = softness * (0.05 + 0.1 * ({{shiftRed}} / 20.0) * bump);
695: float gExtraBlur = softness * 0.05 / max(0.001, abs(1.0 - diagBLtoTR));
696: 
697: vec3 stripW = vec3(thin1Width, thin2Width, wideRatio);
698: stripW.y -= 0.02 * smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, edge + bump);
699: 
700: float stripeR = fract(direction + dispersionRed);
701: float chR = cwGetColorChanges({{colorChrome1}}.r, {{colorChrome2}}.r, stripeR, stripW, blur + fwidth(stripeR) + rExtraBlur, bump);
702: float stripeG = fract(direction);
703: float chG = cwGetColorChanges({{colorChrome1}}.g, {{colorChrome2}}.g, stripeG, stripW, blur + fwidth(stripeG) + gExtraBlur, bump);
704: float stripeB = fract(direction - dispersionBlue);
705: float chB = cwGetColorChanges({{colorChrome1}}.b, {{colorChrome2}}.b, stripeB, stripW, blur + fwidth(stripeB), bump);
706: 
707: vec3 chrome = vec3(chR, chG, chB);
708: // Color burn tint — Paper's tint blend mode
709: chrome = mix(chrome, 1.0 - min(vec3(1.0), (1.0 - chrome) / max({{colorTint}}.rgb, vec3(1e-4))), {{colorTint}}.a);
710: 
711: // Composite chrome over background using silhouette alpha (premultiplied)
712: chrome *= opacity;
713: vec3 bg = {{colorBack}}.rgb * {{colorBack}}.a;
714: vec3 outCol = chrome + bg * (1.0 - opacity);
715: float outA = opacity + {{colorBack}}.a * (1.0 - opacity);
716: return vec4(outCol, outA);`,
717:   },

1: // Multi-pass GL pipeline used by both the live preview and any exported
2: // component. Compiles each pass's program, manages two ping-pong FBOs, and
3: // drives a fullscreen-quad draw per pass. Uniform binding is delegated via
4: // `bindUniforms` so callers can read from React state, props, or an options
5: // object without changing this file.
6: //
7: // IMPORTANT: this file is the single source of truth for the runtime. The
8: // generator inlines its source verbatim into exported React/Vanilla code so
9: // the export and the preview can never drift.
10: //
11: // Texture-unit convention:
12: //   TEXTURE0  — owned by the runtime, bound to `u_prevPass` when read.
13: //   TEXTURE15 — owned by the runtime, bound to `u_noiseTexture` (Paper's
14: //               256×256 RGB noise lookup) for every pass that declares it.
15: //   TEXTURE1..14 — image-uniform binders (callers of `bindUniforms`).
16: // `passContext.nextTextureUnit` reflects the first free unit for that pass.

23:   fragment: string

30:   // pass reads u_prevPass (which sits on TEXTURE0), 0 otherwise.

50:     const sh = gl.createShader(type)
51:     if (!sh) return null
52:     gl.shaderSource(sh, src)
53:     gl.compileShader(sh)
54:     if (!gl.getShaderParameter(sh, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
55:       console.error(
56:         type === gl.VERTEX_SHADER ? 'Vertex' : 'Fragment',
57:         'shader error:',
58:         gl.getShaderInfoLog(sh)
59:       )
60:       gl.deleteShader(sh)
61:       return null
62:     }
63:     return sh
64:   }

66:   const programs: (WebGLProgram | null)[] = passes.map((p) => {
67:     const vs = compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vertexSource)
68:     const fs = compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, p.fragment)
69:     if (!vs || !fs) return null

78:       console.error('Program link error:', gl.getProgramInfoLog(prog))

94:   let fboW = 0

99:   // paper-voronoi, halftone-cmyk, etc.) can sample it without per-layer wiring.

103:   const noiseTexture = gl.createTexture()

150:     const maxAniso = anisoExt

152:       : 1
153:     const make = () => {

156:       gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, w, h, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null)

163:       gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)

182:     texB = tB

195: 
196:     let read: WebGLTexture | null = texA

722: // Operates on the previous pass; pair with `image-source` to refract photos.
723: export const flutedGlassLayer = distorter({
724:   id: 'fluted-glass',
725:   name: 'Fluted Glass',
726:   description: 'Refractive lanes — pair with image-source for fluted-glass effect',
727:   color: '#22d3ee',
728:   uniforms: [
729:     { name: 'size', label: 'Lane Width', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
730:     { name: 'angle', label: 'Angle', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: 0, max: 360, step: 1 } },
731:     { name: 'shape', label: 'Shape', type: 'int', default: 0, ui: { min: 0, max: 2, step: 1 } },
732:     { name: 'distortion', label: 'Distortion', type: 'float', default: 0.5, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
733:     { name: 'highlights', label: 'Highlights', type: 'float', default: 0.4, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
734:     { name: 'shadows', label: 'Shadows', type: 'float', default: 0.4, ui: { min: 0, max: 1, step: 0.01 } },
735:     { name: 'shift', label: 'Shift', type: 'float', default: 0.0, ui: { min: -0.5, max: 0.5, step: 0.01 } },
736:   ],
737:   glsl: {
738:     dependencies: ['rotate2D'],
739:     main: `
740: float patternRotation = -{{angle}} * 3.14159 / 180.0;
741: float patternSize = mix(200.0, 5.0, clamp({{size}}, 0.0, 1.0));
742: vec2 q = (uv - 0.5) * patternSize;
743: q = rotate2D(q, patternRotation);
744: // Per-lane phase: which lane and where in it (0..1).
745: float laneIdx = floor(q.x);
746: float xRaw = fract(q.x);
747: float x = abs(xRaw - 0.5) * 2.0;
748: // Distortion shape: refraction profile across the lane.
749: float distortion = 0.0;
750: if ({{shape}} == 0) {
751:   // cubic bend (linear lens)
752:   distortion = -pow(1.5 * x, 3.0);
753:   distortion += (0.5 - {{shift}});
754: } else if ({{shape}} == 1) {
755:   // quadratic
756:   distortion = 2.0 * pow(x, 2.0);
757:   distortion -= (0.5 + {{shift}});
758: } else {
759:   // sextic concave
760:   distortion = pow(2.0 * (xRaw - 0.5), 6.0);
761:   distortion -= 0.25 + {{shift}};
762: }
763: // Refract: shift the original UV laterally inside each lane by the curve.
764: vec2 dir = vec2(cos(patternRotation), sin(patternRotation));
765: vec2 refractUv = uv + dir * distortion * {{distortion}} * 0.05;
766: vec4 src = texture(u_prevPass, refractUv);
767: // Highlights at lane edges.
768: float edgeWidth = 2.0 * max(0.001, fwidth(xRaw));
769: float edge = smoothstep(0.0, edgeWidth, xRaw) * smoothstep(1.0, 1.0 - edgeWidth, xRaw);
770: float highlight = (1.0 - edge) * {{highlights}};
771: // Shadows: darker interior toward edges.
772: float shadow = pow(x, 1.3) * {{shadows}};
773: vec3 col = src.rgb;
774: col = mix(col, col * (1.0 - shadow), shadow);
775: col = mix(col, vec3(1.0), highlight);
776: return vec4(col, src.a);`,
777:   },
778: })

781: // based on layered value-noise sampled in polar coordinates. Two animated

783: // shapes into smoke-ring-style boundaries.

800: #define PFD_TWO_PI 6.28318530718
801: #endif
802: #ifndef PFD_PI
803: #define PFD_PI 3.14159265359
804: #endif
805: float pfdValueNoise(vec2 st) {
806:   vec2 i = floor(st);
807:   vec2 f = fract(st);
808:   float a = hash21(i);
809:   float b = hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));
810:   float c = hash21(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));
811:   float d = hash21(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));
812:   vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
813:   return mix(mix(a, b, u.x), mix(c, d, u.x), u.y);
814: }
815: vec2 pfdFbm(vec2 n0, vec2 n1, int iters) {
816:   vec2 total = vec2(0.0);
817:   float amp = 0.4;
818:   for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {

820:     total.x += pfdValueNoise(n0) * amp;
821:     total.y += pfdValueNoise(n1) * amp;
822:     n0 *= 1.99;

831:   vec2 right = vec2(fract(polar.x / period) * period, polar.y) + 0.03 * t;
832:   vec2 noise = pfdFbm(left, right, iters);
833:   return mix(noise.y, noise.x, smoothstep(-0.25, 0.25, centred.x));

29: function generateId() {
30:   // Generate a safe ID that starts with a letter (avoid GLSL reserved __ prefix issues)
31:   const chars = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
32:   const first = chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)]
33:   return first + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)
34: }

36: function cloneDefault(value: UniformValue): UniformValue {
37:   if (Array.isArray(value)) return [...value];
38:   if (value && typeof value === "object") {
39:     // Deep copy for ImageUniformValue / Vec4ArrayValue so layer instances
40:     // don't share defaults.
41:     if ("values" in value) {
42:       const v = value as { values: number[][]; length: number };
43:       return { values: v.values.map((c) => [...c]), length: v.length };
44:     }
45:     return { ...value };
46:   }
47:   return value;
48: }
49: 
50: function createLayerInstance(layerType: string): LayerInstance | null {
51:   const definition = LAYER_LIBRARY[layerType];
52:   if (!definition) return null;
53: 
54:   const uniformValues: Record<string, UniformValue> = {};
55:   for (const uniform of definition.uniforms) {
56:     uniformValues[uniform.name] = cloneDefault(uniform.default);
57:   }
58: 
59:   return {
60:     id: generateId(),
61:     layerType,
62:     enabled: true,
63:     blendMode: definition.defaultBlendMode,
64:     opacity: 1,
65:     uniformValues,
66:   };
67: }
68: 
69: function composerReducer(state: ComposerState, action: ComposerAction): ComposerState {
70:   switch (action.type) {
71:     case "ADD_LAYER": {
72:       const instance = createLayerInstance(action.layerType);
73:       if (!instance) return state;
74:       return {
75:         ...state,
76:         layers: [...state.layers, instance],
77:         selectedLayerId: instance.id,
78:       };
79:     }
80:

82:       const newLayers = state.layers.filter((l) => l.id !== action.id);
83:       return {

86:         selectedLayerId:

89:             : state.selectedLayerId,
90:       };

94:       return { ...state, layers: action.layers };
