44: export function ShaderPreview() {
45:   const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
46:   const glRef = useRef<WebGL2RenderingContext | null>(null);
47:   const pipelineRef = useRef<PipelineHandle | null>(null);
48:   const passesRef = useRef<GeneratedPass[]>([]);
49:   const animationRef = useRef<number>(0);
50:   const startTimeRef = useRef<number>(Date.now());
51:   const textureCacheRef = useRef<TextureCache | null>(null);
52: 
53:   const { state } = useComposer();
54: 
55:   useEffect(() => {
56:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
57:     if (!canvas) return;
58: 
59:     const gl = canvas.getContext("webgl2", {
60:       alpha: false,
61:       antialias: true,
62:       premultipliedAlpha: false,
63:     });
64: 
65:     if (!gl) {
66:       console.error("WebGL2 not supported");
67:       return;
68:     }
69:     glRef.current = gl;
70:     textureCacheRef.current = new TextureCache(gl);
71: 
72:     return () => {
73:       cancelAnimationFrame(animationRef.current);
74:       pipelineRef.current?.destroy();
75:       pipelineRef.current = null;
76:       textureCacheRef.current?.destroy();
77:       textureCacheRef.current = null;
78:     };
79:   }, []);
80: 
81:   useEffect(() => {
82:     const gl = glRef.current;
83:     if (!gl) return;
84: 
85:     pipelineRef.current?.destroy();
86:     pipelineRef.current = null;
87:     passesRef.current = [];
88: 
89:     const enabledLayers = state.layers.filter((l) => l.enabled);
90:     if (enabledLayers.length === 0) {
91:       gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
92:       gl.clearColor(0, 0, 0, 1);
93:       gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
94:       return;
95:     }
96: 
97:     const { passes, vertexShader } = generateShader(enabledLayers);
98:     passesRef.current = passes;
99:     pipelineRef.current = createShaderPipeline(
100:       gl,
101:       vertexShader,
102:       passes.map((p) => ({ fragment: p.fragmentShader, readsPrevPass: p.readsPrevPass }))
103:     );
104:   }, [state.layers]);
105: 
106:   useEffect(() => {
107:     const gl = glRef.current;
108:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
109:     if (!gl || !canvas) return;
110: 
111:     const render = () => {
112:       const pipeline = pipelineRef.current;
113:       const passes = passesRef.current;
114:       if (!pipeline || passes.length === 0) {
115:         animationRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(render);
116:         return;
117:       }
118: 
119:       const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
120:       const w = Math.max(1, canvas.clientWidth * dpr);
121:       const h = Math.max(1, canvas.clientHeight * dpr);
122:       if (canvas.width !== w || canvas.height !== h) {
123:         canvas.width = w;
124:         canvas.height = h;
125:       }
126: 
127:       const time = (Date.now() - startTimeRef.current) / 1000;
128: 
129:       pipeline.render(time, w, h, (ctx, program) => {
130:         const pass = passes[ctx.passIndex];
131:         let textureUnit = ctx.nextTextureUnit;
132:         for (const layerId of pass.layerIds) {
133:           const layer = state.layers.find((l) => l.id === layerId);
134:           if (!layer) continue;
135:           const definition = LAYER_LIBRARY[layer.layerType];
136:           if (!definition) continue;
137:           const prefix = sanitizeName(layer.id);
138: 
139:           const opacityLocation = gl.getUniformLocation(
140:             program,
141:             `u_${prefix}_opacity`
142:           );
143:           if (opacityLocation) gl.uniform1f(opacityLocation, layer.opacity);
144: 
145:           for (const uniform of definition.uniforms) {
146:             const baseName = `u_${prefix}_${uniform.name}`;
147:             const value = layer.uniformValues[uniform.name];
148:             if (value === undefined) continue;
149: 
150:             switch (uniform.type) {
151:               case "float":
152:                 gl.uniform1f(
153:                   gl.getUniformLocation(program, baseName),
154:                   value as number
155:                 );
156:                 break;
157:               case "vec2":
158:                 gl.uniform2fv(
159:                   gl.getUniformLocation(program, baseName),
160:                   value as number[]
161:                 );
162:                 break;
163:               case "vec3":
164:                 gl.uniform3fv(
165:                   gl.getUniformLocation(program, baseName),
166:                   value as number[]
167:                 );
168:                 break;
169:               case "vec4":
170:                 gl.uniform4fv(
171:                   gl.getUniformLocation(program, baseName),
172:                   value as number[]
173:                 );
174:                 break;

192:                 if (img?.url && !entry) {
193:                   // Schedule load; this frame uses placeholder.
194:                   cache.prefetch(img.url);
195:                 }
196:                 const tex = entry?.texture ?? cache.getPlaceholder();
197:                 gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0 + textureUnit);
198:                 gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex);
199:                 gl.uniform1i(
200:                   gl.getUniformLocation(program, baseName),

222:                   uniform.arrayLength ?? DEFAULT_VEC4_ARRAY_LENGTH;
223:                 const flat = new Float32Array(len * 4);
224:                 const count = Math.min(value.length, value.values.length, len);
225:                 for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
226:                   const c = value.values[i];
227:                   flat[i * 4 + 0] = c[0] ?? 0;
228:                   flat[i * 4 + 1] = c[1] ?? 0;
229:                   flat[i * 4 + 2] = c[2] ?? 0;
230:                   flat[i * 4 + 3] = c[3] ?? 1;
231:                 }
232:                 gl.uniform4fv(
233:                   gl.getUniformLocation(program, baseName),
234:                   flat
235:                 );
236:                 gl.uniform1i(
237:                   gl.getUniformLocation(program, `${baseName}_count`),
238:                   count
239:                 );
240:                 break;
241:               }
242:             }
243:           }
244:         }
245:       });
246: 
247:       animationRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(render);
248:     };
249: 
250:     animationRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(render);
251:     return () => cancelAnimationFrame(animationRef.current);
252:   }, [state.layers]);
253: 
254:   return (
255:     <canvas
256:       ref={canvasRef}
257:       className="w-full h-full bg-black"
258:     />
259:   );
260: }

1: // Paper preset gallery — compositions of reusable primitives.
2: //
3: // Philosophy: every preset should read like a recipe a designer can understand
4: // from the layer names alone. Avoid monolithic Paper ports where possible;
5: // use the primitive-first approach so users can remix each stack.
6: //
7: // Fidelity labels:
8: //   primitive   — built from composable primitives; canonical version
9: //   approx      — close visual family; missing one primitive capability
10: //   reference   — kept as a monolithic Paper port for comparison only
11: 
12: import type { BlendMode, UniformValue, Vec4ArrayValue } from './types'
13: 
14: export type PaperFidelity = 'primitive' | 'approx' | 'reference'
15: 
16: export interface PaperLayerSpec {
17:   layerType: string
18:   uniformValues: Record<string, UniformValue>
19:   blendMode?: BlendMode
20:   opacity?: number
21: }
22: 
23: export interface PaperPreset {
24:   name: string
25:   fidelity: PaperFidelity
26:   layers: PaperLayerSpec[]
27: }
28: 
29: export interface PaperGroup {
30:   slug: string
31:   name: string

34: }

38: const palette = (...colors: number[][]): Vec4ArrayValue => ({

47:   const b = parseInt(v.substring(4, 6), 16) / 255
48:   const a = v.length === 8 ? parseInt(v.substring(6, 8), 16) / 255 : 1

1: // URL → WebGLTexture cache with LRU eviction and oversize downsampling.
2: // Used by the in-app preview to manage texture lifecycle without thrashing on
3: // every uniform update. Editor-only for now; exported components implement
4: // their own simpler binding.
5: 
6: const MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE = 2048
7: // Upscale tiny / vector images to at least this size so wide-blur shader
8: // sampling doesn't reveal sub-pixel artifacts.
9: const MIN_RASTER_SIZE = 1024
10: // Target SVG rasterization size before upload — matches Paper's preprocessing.
11: const SVG_RASTER_SIZE = 1024
12: const MAX_ENTRIES = 20
13: 
14: interface CacheEntry {
15:   texture: WebGLTexture
16:   width: number
17:   height: number
18:   aspect: number
19:   /** Updated on every getTexture() so eviction picks the oldest. */
20:   lastUsed: number
21: }

23: export class TextureCache {
24:   private gl: WebGL2RenderingContext
25:   private entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>()
26:   private placeholder: WebGLTexture | null = null
27:   private inFlight = new Map<string, Promise<CacheEntry | null>>()
28: 
29:   constructor(gl: WebGL2RenderingContext) {
30:     this.gl = gl
31:   }
32: 
33:   /** 1×1 transparent texture; safe to bind unconditionally as a fallback. */
34:   getPlaceholder(): WebGLTexture {
35:     if (this.placeholder) return this.placeholder
36:     const gl = this.gl
37:     const tex = gl.createTexture()
38:     if (!tex) throw new Error('Failed to allocate placeholder texture')
39:     gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex)
40:     gl.texImage2D(
41:       gl.TEXTURE_2D,
42:       0,
43:       gl.RGBA,
44:       1,
45:       1,
46:       0,
47:       gl.RGBA,
48:       gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,
49:       new Uint8Array([0, 0, 0, 0])
50:     )
51:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)
52:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)
53:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
54:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
55:     this.placeholder = tex
56:     return tex
57:   }
58: 
59:   /** Returns a cached entry synchronously if loaded; otherwise null. */
60:   peek(url: string): CacheEntry | null {
61:     const entry = this.entries.get(url)
62:     if (!entry) return null
63:     entry.lastUsed = performance.now()
64:     return entry
65:   }
66: 
67:   /**
68:    * Loads `url` into a texture (cache or fresh). Calls onReady once the
69:    * upload completes so the renderer can re-render with the new texture.
70:    */
71:   prefetch(url: string, onReady?: () => void): void {
72:     if (this.entries.has(url)) return
73:     if (this.inFlight.has(url)) return
74:     const promise = this.load(url).finally(() => this.inFlight.delete(url))
75:     this.inFlight.set(url, promise)
76:     if (onReady) {
77:       promise.then((entry) => {
78:         if (entry) onReady()
79:       })
80:     }
81:   }
82: 
83:   private async load(url: string): Promise<CacheEntry | null> {
84:     const gl = this.gl
85:     const isSvg = isSvgUrl(url)
86:     let source: TexImageSource | null = null
87:     let w = 0
88:     let h = 0
89:     if (isSvg) {
90:       // For SVGs we want to rasterize at MIN_RASTER_SIZE for crisp blur
91:       // sampling. The browser rasterizes <img> elements at the SVG's
92:       // intrinsic size, so even drawing the result at a larger canvas just
93:       // upscales the low-res raster. Instead, fetch the SVG bytes and give
94:       // them a hard width/height inside the SVG markup itself, then load
95:       // the modified SVG via blob URL — that triggers the browser's SVG
96:       // renderer at the requested resolution.
97:       const rasterized = await rasterizeSvgAtSize(url, SVG_RASTER_SIZE).catch(() => null)
98:       if (!rasterized) return null
99:       source = rasterized
100:       w = rasterized.width
101:       h = rasterized.height
102:     } else {
103:       const img = await loadImage(url).catch(() => null)
104:       if (!img) return null
105:       source = img
106:       w = img.naturalWidth
107:       h = img.naturalHeight
108:     }
109:     const limit = Math.min(
110:       MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE,
111:       gl.getParameter(gl.MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE) as number
112:     )
113:     if (w > limit || h > limit) {
114:       const scale = Math.min(limit / w, limit / h)
115:       const dw = Math.max(1, Math.floor(w * scale))
116:       const dh = Math.max(1, Math.floor(h * scale))
117:       const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
118:       canvas.width = dw
119:       canvas.height = dh
120:       const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
121:       if (ctx) {
122:         ctx.drawImage(source as CanvasImageSource, 0, 0, dw, dh)
123:         source = canvas
124:         w = dw
125:         h = dh
126:       }
127:     }
128:     if (!source) return null
129: 
130:     const tex = gl.createTexture()
131:     if (!tex) return null
132:     gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex)
133:     gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL, true)
134:     gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL, false)
135:     gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, source)
136:     gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL, false)
137:     // WebGL2 supports mipmaps for arbitrary-size textures. Generating them
138:     // and using LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR eliminates the jagged staircases when
139:     // shader code samples the texture at distances larger than its texel
140:     // size — which is exactly what wide-blur passes do.
141:     gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D)
142:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR)
143:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)
144:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
145:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
146:     const anisoExt = gl.getExtension('EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic')
147:     if (anisoExt) {
148:       const maxAniso = gl.getParameter(anisoExt.MAX_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT) as number
149:       gl.texParameterf(gl.TEXTURE_2D, anisoExt.TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT, Math.min(8, maxAniso))
150:     }
151: 
152:     const entry: CacheEntry = {
153:       texture: tex,
154:       width: w,
155:       height: h,
156:       aspect: w / Math.max(1, h),
157:       lastUsed: performance.now(),
158:     }

160:     this.evictIfNeeded()
161:     return entry
162:   }
163: 
164:   private evictIfNeeded() {
165:     if (this.entries.size <= MAX_ENTRIES) return
166:     let oldestKey: string | null = null
167:     let oldestUsed = Infinity
168:     for (const [k, v] of this.entries) {
169:       if (v.lastUsed < oldestUsed) {
170:         oldestUsed = v.lastUsed
171:         oldestKey = k
172:       }
173:     }
174:     if (oldestKey) {

176:       if (dead) this.gl.deleteTexture(dead.texture)
177:       this.entries.delete(oldestKey)

179:   }

183:       this.gl.deleteTexture(entry.texture)
184:     }
185:     this.entries.clear()

193: function isSvgUrl(url: string): boolean {
194:   if (url.startsWith('data:image/svg+xml')) return true
195:   // Strip query/hash before checking extension.
196:   const base = url.split('?')[0].split('#')[0]
197:   return /\.svg$/i.test(base)
198: }
199: 
200: function loadImage(url: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
201:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
202:     const img = new Image()
203:     // dataURLs and blob URLs don't need crossOrigin; only set for absolute http(s).
204:     if (/^https?:/i.test(url)) img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'
205:     img.onload = () => resolve(img)
206:     img.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Failed to load image: ${url}`))
207:     img.src = url
208:   })
209: }

211: // Fetch SVG bytes, inject explicit width/height into the <svg> root so the
212: // browser's SVG renderer rasterizes at the desired size, then return an
213: // HTMLImageElement loaded from the modified SVG. This is the reliable way
214: // to force high-resolution SVG rasterization — setting width/height on a
215: // regular <img> element is just a hint that browsers may ignore when the
216: // SVG markup itself declares a size.
217: async function rasterizeSvgAtSize(url: string, targetSize: number): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
218:   let svgText: string
219:   if (url.startsWith('data:image/svg+xml')) {
220:     const comma = url.indexOf(',')
221:     const payload = url.slice(comma + 1)
222:     if (url.slice(0, comma).includes(';base64')) {
223:       svgText = atob(payload)
224:     } else {
225:       svgText = decodeURIComponent(payload)
226:     }
227:   } else {
228:     const fetchOpts: RequestInit = /^https?:/i.test(url) ? { mode: 'cors' } : {}
229:     const res = await fetch(url, fetchOpts)
230:     svgText = await res.text()
231:   }
232:   // Inject (or replace) width/height on the <svg> root element. Preserve
233:   // the viewBox if present so coordinates still map correctly. If the SVG
234:   // doesn't have a viewBox, derive one from the existing width/height to
235:   // keep the content proportional after scaling.
236:   svgText = svgText.replace(/<svg\b[^>]*>/i, (tag) => {
237:     let next = tag
238:     const hasViewBox = /\bviewBox\s*=/i.test(next)
239:     if (!hasViewBox) {
240:       const w = next.match(/\bwidth\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/i)?.[1]
241:       const h = next.match(/\bheight\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/i)?.[1]
242:       if (w && h) {
243:         next = next.replace('<svg', `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${parseFloat(w)} ${parseFloat(h)}"`)
244:       }
245:     }
246:     next = next.replace(/\swidth\s*=\s*"[^"]*"/i, '')
247:     next = next.replace(/\sheight\s*=\s*"[^"]*"/i, '')
248:     next = next.replace('<svg', `<svg width="${targetSize}" height="${targetSize}"`)
249:     return next
250:   })
251:   const blob = new Blob([svgText], { type: 'image/svg+xml' })
252:   const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
253:   try {
254:     const img = await loadImage(blobUrl)
255:     return img
256:   } finally {
257:     // Defer revocation so the texture upload reads pixel data from a still-valid bitmap.
258:     setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl), 5000)
259:   }

## Critical Context
- The composer uses a linear layer stack that splits into render passes only when `consumesPrevPass: true` (distorters/effects sampling `u_prevPass`). Most Paper shaders are monolithic fragment shaders that combine sizing, pattern generation, color ramping, and compositing in one pass.
- `generator.ts` emits uniforms with a fixed vec4 array length of 10 (`DEFAULT_VEC4_ARRAY_LENGTH`). Paper shaders use variable `maxColorCount` per shader (5–10) and often rely on `u_noiseTexture` (precomputed 256×256 RGB noise) or JS preprocessing (Poisson solver for gem-smoke/heatmap, SVG rasterization, blur kernels).
- The composer’s current layer categories: `generator`, `distorter`, `effect`, `modifier`. Paper shaders need additional concepts: `mask/scalar field`, `preprocessor`, `multi-texture sampler`, `color-space transform`.
- Paper shaders distinguish three UV domains in the vertex shader (`v_objectUV`, `v_patternUV`, `v_imageUV`) with distinct fit/scale/rotation behaviors. The composer currently uses a single `uv` and aspect-corrects in fragment via `SCREEN_P`.
- Several Paper shaders use `dFdx`/`dFdy` and `fwidth` for anti-aliasing; the composer’s `aastep` exists but is not universally applied.

# Decomposition Audit & Gap Analysis

## I. Primitive Taxonomy (Derived from Paper Shared Utils)

Based on `shaders/packages/shaders/src/shader-utils.ts`, `shader-color-spaces.ts`, and `vertex-shader.ts`, the Paper library operates on the following primitive categories:

| Category | Primitives Found | Composer Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Coordinate Transforms** | `rotation2`, aspect-correction (`varyingUV`), `v_objectUV` / `v_patternUV` / `v_imageUV` | Partial (single `uv` only) |
| **Noise / Hash** | `proceduralHash`, `proceduralHash2`, `textureRandomizer`, `valueNoise`, `simplexNoise`, `fiberNoise`, `gaborNoise` | Partial (FBM, some hash) |
| **SDF Sources** | Circle, rounded rect, polygon, metaball, voronoi | Partial (metaballs, basic shapes) |
| **Scalar Fields** | Perlin, simplex, dot-orbit, spiral, smoke-ring, warp, water waves, voronoi | Missing many |
| **Color Ramps** | Multi-stop `u_colors` + `u_colorStops`, OKLCH interpolation | Hardcoded 3-color vec4[10] |
| **Color Spaces** | `srgbToLinear`, `linearToSrgb`, `LrgbToOklab`, `OklabToLrgb`, `oklabToOklch`, `oklchToSrgb`, `oklchMix` | **Completely absent** |
| **Sampling** | `u_prevPass`, `u_mainImage`, `u_imageTexture`, `u_noiseTexture` (TEXTURE15) | Prev pass exists; noise texture missing |
| **Preprocessing** | Poisson solver (gem-smoke, heatmap), blur kernels, dithering matrices, SVG rasterization | **Not implemented** |
| **Post-process / Effects** | `colorBandingFix`, god-rays, fluted glass (refraction), dithering, halftone | Partial (fluted glass started) |

---

## II. Per-Shader Primitive Recipes

### Priority: Heatmap
**File**: `shaders/packages/shaders/src/shaders/heatmap.ts`

**Decomposition**:
1. **Preprocess**: JavaScript Poisson solver on source image to create `u_poissonTexture` (relaxation steps on luminance).
2. **Scalar Field**: Modified noise gradient magnitude from Poisson output + `varyingUV`.
3. **Color Ramp**: 8-stop OKLCH palette (`u_colorsHeat`, `u_colorsCold`), mixing via `oklchMix`.
4. **Post-process**: `colorBandingFix`.

**Composer Gaps**:
- No Poisson solver in runtime or texture pipeline.
- No 8-stop `vec4Array` UI support (max 10 hardcoded, but UI assumes 3).
- No `oklchMix` / OKLCH color space layer.

---

### Priority: Liquid Metal
**File**: `shaders/packages/shaders/src/shaders/liquid-metal.ts`

**Decomposition**:
1. **Coordinate Transform**: Aspect-corrected `varyingUV`.
2. **Scalar Field**: Layered domain-warped simplex noise (`simplexNoise` with `rotation2`).
3. **SDF Modifier**: Thresholded noise creating "liquid" blob edges.
4. **Color Ramp**: 5-stop metallic palette with specular highlights derived from noise gradient.
5. **Post-process**: `colorBandingFix`.

**Composer Gaps**:
- Missing `rotation2` helper in `glsl-utils.ts`.
- Missing `simplexNoise` (has FBM but not Paper's specific 3D simplex).
- Missing domain-warp primitive (distortion of UVs by noise field before sampling).
- Color ramp needs 5-stop support with OKLCH for metallic gradients.

---

### Additional Key Shaders (Selected Gaps)

| Shader | Missing Primitive |
|---|---|
| `god-rays` | Volumetric ray-march sampling of `u_mainImage`; requires `u_prevPass` as background or separate blur layer |
| `fluted-glass` | Refractive UV offset using `dFdx`/`dFdy` on noise; partially started in `distorters.ts` at line 721 |
| `gem-smoke` | Poisson solver + OKLCH smoke color ramp + `colorBandingFix` |
| `water` | Domain-warped simplex + normal-map derivative lighting |
| `warp` | Polar coordinate transform + procedural hash warp |
| `pulsing-border` | SDF rounded rect + time-modulated thickness + glow field |
| `color-panels` | Grid SDF + per-cell random color assignment (procedural hash) |
| `halftone-cmyk` / `halftone-dots` | CMYK separation + dot SDF sampling; requires `u_mainImage` |
| `image-dithering` | Bayer/ordered matrix thresholding of `u_mainImage` luminance |
| `grain-gradient` | Film grain overlay + multi-stop gradient |
| `static-mesh-gradient` / `mesh-gradient` | Barycentric gradient interpolation in UV space (different vertex UV logic) |
| `dot-grid` / `dot-orbit` | Procedural hash + SDF circle + orbital motion |

## III. Concrete Patch List (Prioritised)

### Phase 1: Foundation (Required for all 1:1 ports)

**A. `src/lib/shader-composer/types.ts`**
- Add `outputKind: 'scalar' | 'rgba'` to `LayerDefinition`. Heatmap and many SDF shaders generate scalar masks before colorization.
- Extend `UniformValue` union to include `vec2Array`, `vec3Array`, and bounded `vec4Array` (variable length up to 10).
- Add `preprocessor?: 'poisson' | 'blur' | 'bayer-dither'` to layer config for JS-side image prep.

**B. `src/lib/shader-composer/glsl-utils.ts`**
- Port `rotation2` (lines 1-3 of `shader-utils.ts`).
- Port `declarePI` and `declareOklchTransforms` (from `shader-color-spaces.ts`).
- Port `simplexNoise`, `valueNoise`, `fiberNoise`, `proceduralHash`, `proceduralHash2`, `textureRandomizer`.
- Port `colorBandingFix`.
- Add `domainWarp(uv, noiseField, amplitude)` helper.

**C. `src/lib/shader-composer/generator.ts`**
- Support scalar-to-RGBA promotion (when a scalar layer feeds into an RGBA blend).
- Support variable-length `vec4Array` uniform emission (currently unrolls exactly 10; needs `maxColorCount` dynamic unroll).
- Implement noise texture binding: inject `u_noiseTexture` on TEXTURE15 if any layer declares `needsNoiseTexture: true`.
- Implement multi-UV vertex shader output (`v_objectUV`, `v_patternUV`, `v_imageUV`) if any layer requests it.

### Phase 2: Liquid Metal & Heatmap (User Priority)

**D. New Layer: `src/lib/shader-composer/layers/scalar-fields.ts`**
- `liquidMetalField`: Domain-warped simplex → scalar.
- `heatmapField`: Gradient magnitude from input texture → scalar.

**E. New Layer: `src/lib/shader-composer/layers/color-spaces.ts`**
- `oklchRamp`: Multi-stop OKLCH color ramp layer (replaces current 3-stop gradient for fidelity).
- `oklchMix` modifier.

**F. Runtime Preprocessing: `src/lib/shader-composer/runtime-shell.ts`**
- Add Poisson solver canvas helper for `heatmap` and `gem-smoke`.
- Add Bayer matrix generation for `image-dithering`.

### Phase 3: Remaining Shader Ports

**G. Expand `layers/sources.ts`**
- `godRaysVolume`: Ray-march sampling.
- `halftoneCmyk`, `halftoneDots`: CMYK dot SDF sampling.
- `ditheredImage`: Ordered dither threshold.

**H. Expand `layers/shapes.ts` & `layers/patterns.ts`**
- `roundedRectSDF`, `polygonSDF`, `gridSDF` for `color-panels`, `pulsing-border`.
- `polarWarp` for `warp` shader.

## IV. Vertex Stage Decision Required

To achieve true 1:1 fidelity, we must replicate Paper's vertex shader (`shaders/packages/shaders/src/vertex-shader.ts`) which computes three distinct UV sets:

- `v_objectUV`: Aspect-corrected object-space coordinates
- `v_patternUV`: Pattern-space coordinates (tiling/repeat)
- `v_imageUV`: Image sampler coordinates

# Specification: Paper Shader Decomposition & Composer Extension

## 1. Vertex Stage Extension (`generator.ts`, `types.ts`)

### New Types in `types.ts`

```typescript
// Added to LayerDefinition
uvDomains?: ('object' | 'pattern' | 'image')[];

// New outputKind for scalar fields
outputKind?: 'scalar' | 'rgba'; // defaults to rgba

// New preprocessor hooks
preprocessor?: 'poisson' | 'blur' | 'bayer-dither';
needsNoiseTexture?: boolean;
```

### Vertex Shader Generation Logic in `generator.ts`

When any layer declares `uvDomains`, the generator must emit a custom vertex shader instead of the default passthrough.

**Injects:**
- `varying vec2 v_objectUV;`
- `varying vec2 v_patternUV;`
- `varying vec2 v_imageUV;`

**Computes:**
- `v_objectUV`: aspect-corrected object-space coordinates (from `a_vertex` / `u_resolution`)
- `v_patternUV`: tiling/repeat coordinates (pattern-space scaling)
- `v_imageUV`: direct image sampler coordinates

**Fragment mapping:** Layers request `uvDomain: 'object' | 'pattern' | 'image'` and receive the corresponding varying.

---

## 2. GLSL Utility Library Expansion (`glsl-utils.ts`)

Port the following from Paper's shared utilities:

### Coordinate Transforms
```glsl
mat2 rotation2(float angle);
vec2 aspectCorrectUV(vec2 uv, vec2 resolution);
```

### Hash & Noise (Procedural)
```glsl
float proceduralHash(vec2 p);
vec2 proceduralHash2(vec2 p);
float textureRandomizer(vec2 p);
float valueNoise(vec2 p);
float simplexNoise(vec3 p); // 3D variant for liquid metal
float fiberNoise(vec2 p);
```

### Color Spaces (Critical for Heatmap, Gem-Smoke)
```glsl
vec3 srgbToLinear(vec3 c);
vec3 linearToSrgb(vec3 c);
vec3 LrgbToOklab(vec3 c);
vec3 OklabToLrgb(vec3 c);
vec3 oklabToOklch(vec3 c);
vec3 oklchToSrgb(vec3 c);
vec3 oklchMix(vec3 c1, vec3 c2, float t);
```

### Post-Process
```glsl
float colorBandingFix(float color);
vec3 colorBandingFix(vec3 color);
```

### Domain Warp
```glsl
vec2 domainWarp(vec2 uv, float noiseField, float amplitude);
```

---

## 3. Variable-Length Color Arrays (`generator.ts`, `property-panel.tsx`)

### Generator Changes
- Accept `maxColorCount: number` per layer (1–10).
- Unroll `u_colors` and `u_colorStops` arrays dynamically based on `maxColorCount`, not fixed 10.
- Emit `int u_colorCount` uniform for loop bounds.

### Property Panel Changes
- `vec4Array` control must support variable length (1–10 stops).
- Add min/max length props to `vec4Array` uniform type.
- UI renders color stop inputs up to `maxColorCount`.

---

## 4. Noise Texture Binding (`runtime-shell.ts`, `generator.ts`)

### Generator
- If any layer has `needsNoiseTexture: true`, inject:
  ```glsl
  uniform sampler2D u_noiseTexture;
  ```
- Map to texture unit **TEXTURE15** (Paper convention).

### Runtime Shell
- On shell initialization, generate or load 256×256 RGB noise texture.
- Bind to TEXTURE15 for all passes if any layer requires it.
- Cache in `texture-cache.ts`.

---

## 5. Preprocessing Pipeline (`runtime-shell.ts`, `layers/`)

### Poisson Solver (Heatmap, Gem-Smoke)
- **Input**: `u_imageTexture` or source image.
- **Process**: 10–20 Jacobi relaxation iterations on luminance channel via offscreen canvas/texture.
- **Output**: `u_poissonTexture` passed as sampler to fragment layer.

### Bayer Matrix (Image-Dithering)
- Generate standard 8×8 Bayer matrix as `sampler2D` or `float[64]` uniform.
- Precompute on JS side, upload as texture.

---

## 6. New Primitive Layers

### `layers/scalar-fields.ts` (NEW FILE)
- `liquidMetalField`: Domain-warped simplex → scalar output.
- `heatmapGradientField`: Gradient magnitude sampler → scalar output.
- `perlinField`, `voronoiField`, `dotOrbitField`: Existing noise.ts fields refactored to output scalar.

### `layers/color-spaces.ts` (NEW FILE)
- `oklchRamp`: Multi-stop OKLCH gradient.
  - Uniforms: `u_colors[10]`, `u_stops[10]`, `u_colorCount`
  - Uses `oklchMix` for interpolation.
- `srgbToLinearModifier`, `linearToSrgbModifier`.

### `layers/distorters.ts` (EXTEND)
- Complete `flutedGlassLayer` (line 721+) with proper `dFdx`/`dFdy` refractive offsets.
- Add `domainWarpDistorter`: UV displacement by noise field.

### `layers/sources.ts` (EXTEND)
- `godRaysVolume`: Ray-march from light source through `u_prevPass` / `u_mainImage`.
- `halftoneCmyk`: CMYK channel separation + dot SDF.
- `halftoneDots`: Monochrome dot SDF.

### `layers/shapes.ts` (EXTEND)
- `roundedRectSDF`: For `pulsing-border`, `color-panels`.
- `polygonSDF`: Generic polygon SDF.
- `gridSDF`: Repetition primitive for `color-panels`.

### `layers/stylize.ts` (EXTEND)
- `colorBandingFixLayer`: Post-process pass using Paper's fix.

---

## 7. Pass Splitting Logic (`generator.ts`)

### Rules
1. **Scalar layers** do not split passes; they write to `u_prevPass` as `vec4(scalar, 0, 0, 1)` or use a scalar attachment.
2. **RGBA layers** writing to `u_prevPass` split as before.
3. **Post-process layers** (`colorBandingFixLayer`, `godRaysVolume` if sampling prev pass) always split.
4. **Preprocessing layers** (Poisson, blur) execute on CPU/offscreen before the first render pass.

## 9. Liquid Metal Composition Recipe

```
Layer Stack:
1. [Generator] liquidMetalField (scalar)
   - simplexNoise domain-warped by rotation2
   - Outputs: scalar field (0-1)
2. [Modifier] scalarToRGBA (promote scalar to alpha/height map)
3. [Generator] oklchRamp (RGBA)
   - 5-stop metallic palette
   - Specular highlight based on scalar gradient
4. [Effect] colorBandingFix (RGBA)
5. [Blend] Composite over background
```

## 10. Heatmap Composition Recipe

```
Preprocess:
- JS Poisson solver on input image → u_poissonTexture

Layer Stack:
1. [Generator] heatmapGradientField (scalar)
   - Samples u_poissonTexture, computes gradient magnitude
2. [Modifier] scalarRemap (scalar)
   - Remaps gradient to 0-1 heat intensity
3. [Generator] oklchRamp (RGBA)
   - 8-stop palette (cold blues → hot reds)
   - u_colorsCold[], u_colorsHeat[]
4. [Effect] colorBandingFix (RGBA)
5. [Blend] Composite over source or transparent
```

# Skill: threejs-shaders

# Three.js Shaders

## Quick Start

```javascript
import * as THREE from "three";

const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    time: { value: 0 },
    color: { value: new THREE.Color(0xff0000) },
  },
  vertexShader: `
    void main() {
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    uniform vec3 color;

    void main() {
      gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});

// Update in animation loop
material.uniforms.time.value = clock.getElapsedTime();
```

## ShaderMaterial vs RawShaderMaterial

### ShaderMaterial

Three.js provides built-in uniforms and attributes.

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    // Built-in uniforms available:
    // uniform mat4 modelMatrix;
    // uniform mat4 modelViewMatrix;
    // uniform mat4 projectionMatrix;
    // uniform mat4 viewMatrix;
    // uniform mat3 normalMatrix;
    // uniform vec3 cameraPosition;

    // Built-in attributes available:
    // attribute vec3 position;
    // attribute vec3 normal;
    // attribute vec2 uv;

    void main() {
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    void main() {
      gl_FragColor = vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

### RawShaderMaterial

Full control - you define everything.

```javascript
const material = new THREE.RawShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    projectionMatrix: { value: camera.projectionMatrix },
    modelViewMatrix: { value: new THREE.Matrix4() },
  },
  vertexShader: `
    precision highp float;

    attribute vec3 position;
    uniform mat4 projectionMatrix;
    uniform mat4 modelViewMatrix;

    void main() {
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    precision highp float;

    void main() {
      gl_FragColor = vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

## Uniforms

### Uniform Types

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    // Numbers
    floatValue: { value: 1.5 },
    intValue: { value: 1 },

    // Vectors
    vec2Value: { value: new THREE.Vector2(1, 2) },
    vec3Value: { value: new THREE.Vector3(1, 2, 3) },
    vec4Value: { value: new THREE.Vector4(1, 2, 3, 4) },

    // Colors (converted to vec3)
    colorValue: { value: new THREE.Color(0xff0000) },

    // Matrices
    mat3Value: { value: new THREE.Matrix3() },
    mat4Value: { value: new THREE.Matrix4() },

    // Textures
    textureValue: { value: texture },
    cubeTextureValue: { value: cubeTexture },

    // Arrays
    floatArray: { value: [1.0, 2.0, 3.0] },
    vec3Array: {
      value: [new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0)],
    },
  },
});
```

### GLSL Declarations

```glsl
// In shader
uniform float floatValue;
uniform int intValue;
uniform vec2 vec2Value;
uniform vec3 vec3Value;
uniform vec3 colorValue;    // Color becomes vec3
uniform vec4 vec4Value;
uniform mat3 mat3Value;
uniform mat4 mat4Value;
uniform sampler2D textureValue;
uniform samplerCube cubeTextureValue;
uniform float floatArray[3];
uniform vec3 vec3Array[2];
```

### Updating Uniforms

```javascript
// Direct assignment
material.uniforms.time.value = clock.getElapsedTime();

// Vector/Color updates
material.uniforms.position.value.set(x, y, z);
material.uniforms.color.value.setHSL(hue, 1, 0.5);

// Matrix updates
material.uniforms.matrix.value.copy(mesh.matrixWorld);
```

## Varyings

Pass data from vertex to fragment shader.

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec2 vUv;
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vPosition;

    void main() {
      vUv = uv;
      vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
      vPosition = (modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0)).xyz;

      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    varying vec2 vUv;
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vPosition;

    void main() {
      // Use interpolated values
      gl_FragColor = vec4(vNormal * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

## Common Shader Patterns

### Texture Sampling

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    map: { value: texture },
  },
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec2 vUv;

    void main() {
      vUv = uv;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    uniform sampler2D map;
    varying vec2 vUv;

    void main() {
      vec4 texColor = texture2D(map, vUv);
      gl_FragColor = texColor;
    }
  `,
});
```

### Vertex Displacement

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    time: { value: 0 },
    amplitude: { value: 0.5 },
  },
  vertexShader: `
    uniform float time;
    uniform float amplitude;

    void main() {
      vec3 pos = position;

      // Wave displacement
      pos.z += sin(pos.x * 5.0 + time) * amplitude;
      pos.z += sin(pos.y * 5.0 + time) * amplitude;

      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(pos, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    void main() {
      gl_FragColor = vec4(0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

### Fresnel Effect

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

    void main() {
      vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
      vWorldPosition = (modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0)).xyz;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vWorldPosition;

    void main() {
      // cameraPosition is auto-provided by ShaderMaterial
      vec3 viewDirection = normalize(cameraPosition - vWorldPosition);
      float fresnel = pow(1.0 - dot(viewDirection, vNormal), 3.0);

      vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.5);
      vec3 fresnelColor = vec3(0.5, 0.8, 1.0);

      gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(baseColor, fresnelColor, fresnel), 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

### Noise-Based Effects

```glsl
// Simple noise function
float random(vec2 st) {
  return fract(sin(dot(st.xy, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453);
}

// Value noise
float noise(vec2 st) {
  vec2 i = floor(st);
  vec2 f = fract(st);

  float a = random(i);
  float b = random(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0));
  float c = random(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0));
  float d = random(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0));

  vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);

  return mix(a, b, u.x) + (c - a) * u.y * (1.0 - u.x) + (d - b) * u.x * u.y;
}

// Usage
float n = noise(vUv * 10.0 + time);
```

### Gradient

```glsl
// Linear gradient
vec3 color = mix(colorA, colorB, vUv.y);

// Radial gradient
float dist = distance(vUv, vec2(0.5));
vec3 color = mix(centerColor, edgeColor, dist * 2.0);

// Smooth gradient with custom curve
float t = smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, vUv.y);
vec3 color = mix(colorA, colorB, t);
```

### Rim Lighting

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vViewPosition;

    void main() {
      vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
      vec4 mvPosition = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      vViewPosition = mvPosition.xyz;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mvPosition;
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    varying vec3 vNormal;
    varying vec3 vViewPosition;

    void main() {
      vec3 viewDir = normalize(-vViewPosition);
      float rim = 1.0 - max(0.0, dot(viewDir, vNormal));
      rim = pow(rim, 4.0);

      vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.2, 0.2, 0.8);
      vec3 rimColor = vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0);

      gl_FragColor = vec4(baseColor + rimColor * rim, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

### Dissolve Effect

```glsl
uniform float progress;
uniform sampler2D noiseMap;

void main() {
  float noise = texture2D(noiseMap, vUv).r;

  if (noise < progress) {
    discard;
  }

  // Edge glow
  float edge = smoothstep(progress, progress + 0.1, noise);
  vec3 edgeColor = vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.0);
  vec3 baseColor = vec3(0.5);

  gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(edgeColor, baseColor, edge), 1.0);
}
```

## Extending Built-in Materials

### onBeforeCompile

Modify existing material shaders.

```javascript
const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x00ff00 });

material.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {
  // Add custom uniform
  shader.uniforms.time = { value: 0 };

  // Store reference for updates
  material.userData.shader = shader;

  // Modify vertex shader
  shader.vertexShader = shader.vertexShader.replace(
    "#include <begin_vertex>",
    `
    #include <begin_vertex>
    transformed.y += sin(position.x * 10.0 + time) * 0.1;
    `,
  );

  // Add uniform declaration
  shader.vertexShader = "uniform float time;\n" + shader.vertexShader;
};

// Update in animation loop
if (material.userData.shader) {
  material.userData.shader.uniforms.time.value = clock.getElapsedTime();
}
```

### Common Injection Points

```javascript
// Vertex shader chunks
"#include <begin_vertex>"; // After position is calculated
"#include <project_vertex>"; // After gl_Position
"#include <beginnormal_vertex>"; // Normal calculation start

// Fragment shader chunks
"#include <color_fragment>"; // After diffuse color
"#include <output_fragment>"; // Final output
"#include <fog_fragment>"; // After fog applied
```

## GLSL Built-in Functions

### Math Functions

```glsl
// Basic
abs(x), sign(x), floor(x), ceil(x), fract(x)
mod(x, y), min(x, y), max(x, y), clamp(x, min, max)
mix(a, b, t), step(edge, x), smoothstep(edge0, edge1, x)

// Trigonometry
sin(x), cos(x), tan(x)
asin(x), acos(x), atan(y, x), atan(x)
radians(degrees), degrees(radians)

// Exponential
pow(x, y), exp(x), log(x), exp2(x), log2(x)
sqrt(x), inversesqrt(x)
```

### Vector Functions

```glsl
// Length and distance
length(v), distance(p0, p1), dot(x, y), cross(x, y)

// Normalization
normalize(v)

// Reflection and refraction
reflect(I, N), refract(I, N, eta)

// Component-wise
lessThan(x, y), lessThanEqual(x, y)
greaterThan(x, y), greaterThanEqual(x, y)
equal(x, y), notEqual(x, y)
any(bvec), all(bvec)
```

### Texture Functions

```glsl
// GLSL 1.0 (default) - use texture2D/textureCube
texture2D(sampler, coord)
texture2D(sampler, coord, bias)
textureCube(sampler, coord)

// GLSL 3.0 (glslVersion: THREE.GLSL3) - use texture()
// texture(sampler, coord) replaces texture2D/textureCube
// Also use: out vec4 fragColor instead of gl_FragColor

// Texture size (GLSL 1.30+)
textureSize(sampler, lod)
```

## Common Material Properties

```javascript
const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms: {
    /* ... */
  },
  vertexShader: "/* ... */",

  // Rendering

  opacity: 1.0,
  side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  depthTest: true,
  depthWrite: true,

  // Blending
  blending: THREE.NormalBlending,
  // AdditiveBlending, SubtractiveBlending, MultiplyBlending

  // Wireframe

  wireframeLinewidth: 1, // Note: >1 has no effect on most platforms (WebGL limitation)

  // Extensions
  extensions: {
    derivatives: true, // For fwidth, dFdx, dFdy
    fragDepth: true, // gl_FragDepth
    drawBuffers: true, // Multiple render targets
    shaderTextureLOD: true, // texture2DLod
  },

  // GLSL version
  glslVersion: THREE.GLSL3, // For WebGL2 features
});

## Shader Includes

### Using Three.js Shader Chunks

```javascript
import { ShaderChunk } from "three";

const fragmentShader = `
  ${ShaderChunk.common}
  ${ShaderChunk.packing}

  uniform sampler2D depthTexture;
  varying vec2 vUv;

  void main() {
    float depth = texture2D(depthTexture, vUv).r;
    float linearDepth = perspectiveDepthToViewZ(depth, 0.1, 1000.0);
    gl_FragColor = vec4(vec3(-linearDepth / 100.0), 1.0);
  }
`;
```

### External Shader Files

```javascript
// With vite/webpack
import vertexShader from "./shaders/vertex.glsl";
import fragmentShader from "./shaders/fragment.glsl";

const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader,
  fragmentShader,
});
```

## Instanced Shaders

```javascript
// Instanced attribute
const offsets = new Float32Array(instanceCount * 3);
// Fill offsets...
geometry.setAttribute("offset", new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(offsets, 3));

const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexShader: `
    attribute vec3 offset;

    void main() {
      vec3 pos = position + offset;
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(pos, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    void main() {
      gl_FragColor = vec4(1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    }
  `,
});
```

// Check for compile errors

};

// Visual debugging
fragmentShader: `
  void main() {
    // Debug UV
    gl_FragColor = vec4(vUv, 0.0, 1.0);

    // Debug normals
    gl_FragColor = vec4(vNormal * 0.5 + 0.5, 1.0);

    // Debug position
    gl_FragColor = vec4(vPosition * 0.1 + 0.5, 1.0);
  }
`;

// Check WebGL errors
renderer.debug.checkShaderErrors = true;
```

## Performance Tips

1. **Minimize uniforms**: Group related values into vectors
2. **Avoid conditionals**: Use mix/step instead of if/else
3. **Precalculate**: Move calculations to JS when possible
4. **Use textures**: For complex functions, use lookup tables
5. **Limit overdraw**: Avoid transparent objects when possible

```glsl
// Instead of:
if (value > 0.5) {
  color = colorA;
} else {
  color = colorB;
}

// Use:
color = mix(colorB, colorA, step(0.5, value));
```

338: // All uniforms except runtime-managed `u_time` / `u_resolution` are exposed

343:   return !['u_time', 'u_resolution'].includes(u.name)

346: function generateTypeScript(

354:       const defaultVal = formatDefault(u.default, u.type)
355:       return `  /** ${u.layerName} - ${u.originalName} */\n  ${camelCase(
356:         u.name
357:       )}?: ${tsType} // default: ${defaultVal}`
358:     })
359:     .join('\n')
360: 
361:   return `export interface ${shaderName}Props {
362: ${propsInterface}
363: }
364: 
365: export const ${shaderName.toLowerCase()}Defaults: Required<${shaderName}Props> = {
366: ${exportable
367:   .map((u) => `  ${camelCase(u.name)}: ${formatDefault(u.default, u.type)},`)
368:   .join('\n')}

382:   const propsWithDefaults = propUniforms
383:     .map((u) => `    ${camelCase(u.name)} = ${formatDefault(u.default, u.type)},`)
384:     .join('\n')
385:   const bindLines = propUniforms
386:     .map((u) => '    ' + emitUniformBind(u, camelCase(u.name)))
387:     .join('\n')
388:   const ensureLines = samplerUniforms
389:     .map((u) => `    imageCacheRef.current?.ensure(${camelCase(u.name)})`)
390:     .join('\n')
391: 
392:   const escapedVertex = escape(vertexShader)
393:   const passSources = passes

395:       (p) =>
396:         `  { fragment: \`${escape(p.fragmentShader)}\`, readsPrevPass: ${p.readsPrevPass} },`
397:     )

306:   vec3 p = abs(fract(c.xxx + K.xyz) * 6.0 - K.www);

315:   hash21: `

323:   hash22: `
324: vec2 hash22(vec2 p) {
325:   p = fract(p * vec2(0.3183099, 0.3678794)) + 0.1;
326:   p += dot(p, p.yx + 19.19);
327:   return fract(vec2(p.x * p.y, p.x + p.y));

339:   // gives a discrete 1-cell-per-input lookup that's much better-distributed

341:   noiseTextureRandomR: `

347: vec2 noiseTextureRandomGB(vec2 p) {

351:   // Sampler-helper: maps canvas-space UV in [0,1] to image-space UV, honouring
352:   // image aspect, fit mode (0=cover, 1=contain, 2=fill), uniform scale, rotation
353:   // (radians) and pixel-space offset. Canvas aspect comes from u_resolution.
354:   // Meta layout: (imgAspect, fitMode, scale, rotation). Offset is vec2 in UV.
355:   applySizing: `
356: vec2 applySizing(vec2 uv, vec4 meta, vec2 offset) {
357:   vec2 c = uv - 0.5 - offset;
358:   float canvasAspect = u_resolution.x / max(u_resolution.y, 1.0);
359:   float imgAspect = max(meta.x, 1e-4);
360:   float fitMode = meta.y;
361:   float scale = max(meta.z, 1e-4);
362:   float rot = meta.w;
363:   // Rotate around center.
364:   float ca = cos(rot);
365:   float sa = sin(rot);
366:   c = vec2(c.x * ca - c.y * sa, c.x * sa + c.y * ca);
367:   // Aspect correction. Cover (default) fills the canvas; contain letterboxes;
368:   // fill stretches.
369:   vec2 ratio = vec2(1.0);
370:   if (fitMode < 0.5) {
371:     // cover: shrink the axis with smaller "image fits" so image fills canvas.
372:     if (canvasAspect > imgAspect) {
373:       ratio = vec2(1.0, imgAspect / canvasAspect);
374:     } else {
375:       ratio = vec2(canvasAspect / imgAspect, 1.0);
376:     }
377:   } else if (fitMode < 1.5) {
378:     // contain: opposite axis.
379:     if (canvasAspect > imgAspect) {
380:       ratio = vec2(imgAspect / canvasAspect, 1.0);
381:     } else {
382:       ratio = vec2(1.0, canvasAspect / imgAspect);
383:     }
384:   } // fill: ratio stays (1,1).
385:   c /= max(scale, 1e-4);
386:   c /= ratio;
387:   return c + 0.5;
388: }`,
389: 
390:   // Smooth/stepped color-ramp lookup over a fixed-size vec4 palette.
391:   // steps=0 → smooth, steps>0 → quantised globally.
392:   // stepsPerColor>0 → quantise within each color segment.
393:   // softness controls blend sharpness (0=hard, 1=fully smooth).
394:   // wrap=true → palette repeats; wrap=false → clamp at last color.
395:   // The fixed array length 10 must match RAMP_MAX in the generator emission.
396:   colorRampLookup: `
397: vec4 colorRampLookup(float t, vec4 colors[10], int count, int steps, float softness, int stepsPerColor, bool wrap) {
398:   int n = max(count, 1);
399:   if (n == 1) return colors[0];
400:   float tc = clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);
401:   if (wrap) tc = fract(tc);
402:   if (steps > 0) {
403:     float fSteps = float(steps);
404:     tc = floor(tc * fSteps) / max(fSteps - 1.0, 1.0);
405:     tc = clamp(tc, 0.0, 1.0);
406:   }
407:   float seg = tc * float(n - 1);
408:   int i0 = int(floor(seg));
409:   int i1 = i0 + 1;
410:   if (i1 > n - 1) i1 = wrap ? 0 : n - 1;
411:   float f = seg - float(i0);
412:   if (stepsPerColor > 1) {
413:     float spc = float(stepsPerColor);
414:     f = floor(f * spc) / max(spc - 1.0, 1.0);
415:     f = clamp(f, 0.0, 1.0);
416:   }
417:   float fw = fwidth(f);
418:   float s = max(softness, 0.0);
419:   f = smoothstep(0.5 - s - fw, 0.5 + s + fw, f);
420:   vec4 a = colors[i0];
421:   vec4 b = colors[i1];
422:   return mix(a, b, f);
423: }`,

434:   c += texture(src, uv + vec2( r.x, -r.y)) * 0.0707;

1: // Multi-pass GL pipeline used by both the live preview and any exported
2: // component. Compiles each pass's program, manages two ping-pong FBOs, and
3: // drives a fullscreen-quad draw per pass. Uniform binding is delegated via
4: // `bindUniforms` so callers can read from React state, props, or an options
5: // object without changing this file.
6: //
7: // IMPORTANT: this file is the single source of truth for the runtime. The
8: // generator inlines its source verbatim into exported React/Vanilla code so
9: // the export and the preview can never drift.
10: //
11: // Texture-unit convention:
12: //   TEXTURE0  — owned by the runtime, bound to `u_prevPass` when read.
13: //   TEXTURE15 — owned by the runtime, bound to `u_noiseTexture` (Paper's
14: //               256×256 RGB noise lookup) for every pass that declares it.
15: //   TEXTURE1..14 — image-uniform binders (callers of `bindUniforms`).
16: // `passContext.nextTextureUnit` reflects the first free unit for that pass.

23:   fragment: string
24:   readsPrevPass: boolean

27: export interface PassContext {
28:   passIndex: number
29:   // First texture unit available to image uniforms in this pass. 1 if the
30:   // pass reads u_prevPass (which sits on TEXTURE0), 0 otherwise.
31:   nextTextureUnit: number
32: }

36:     time: number,

44: export function createShaderPipeline(
45:   gl: WebGL2RenderingContext,
46:   vertexSource: string,
47:   passes: PipelinePass[]

49:   function compile(type: number, src: string): WebGLShader | null {
50:     const sh = gl.createShader(type)
51:     if (!sh) return null
52:     gl.shaderSource(sh, src)
53:     gl.compileShader(sh)
54:     if (!gl.getShaderParameter(sh, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) {
55:       console.error(
56:         type === gl.VERTEX_SHADER ? 'Vertex' : 'Fragment',
57:         'shader error:',
58:         gl.getShaderInfoLog(sh)
59:       )
60:       gl.deleteShader(sh)
61:       return null
62:     }
63:     return sh
64:   }
65: 
66:   const programs: (WebGLProgram | null)[] = passes.map((p) => {
67:     const vs = compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vertexSource)
68:     const fs = compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, p.fragment)
69:     if (!vs || !fs) return null
70:     const prog = gl.createProgram()
71:     if (!prog) return null
72:     gl.attachShader(prog, vs)
73:     gl.attachShader(prog, fs)
74:     gl.linkProgram(prog)
75:     gl.deleteShader(vs)
76:     gl.deleteShader(fs)
77:     if (!gl.getProgramParameter(prog, gl.LINK_STATUS)) {
78:       console.error('Program link error:', gl.getProgramInfoLog(prog))
79:       gl.deleteProgram(prog)
80:       return null
81:     }
82:     return prog
83:   })

86:   const buffer = gl.createBuffer()
87:   gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buffer)

94:   let fboW = 0
95:   let fboH = 0

97:   // Paper's 256×256 RGB noise texture. Bound globally on TEXTURE15 every pass
98:   // so any layer that references `u_noiseTexture` (smoke-ring, warp, god-rays,
99:   // paper-voronoi, halftone-cmyk, etc.) can sample it without per-layer wiring.
100:   // The image loads asynchronously; we upload pixels to the texture once it

103:   const noiseTexture = gl.createTexture()

137:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.REPEAT)

146:     if (fboB) gl.deleteFramebuffer(fboB)
147:     fboW = w

150:     const maxAniso = anisoExt

153:     const make = () => {
154:       const t = gl.createTexture()
155:       gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, t)
156:       gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, w, h, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, null)

166:       if (anisoExt) {

175:       gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, t, 0)

178:     const [tA, fA] = make()
179:     texA = tA
180:     fboA = fA
181:     const [tB, fB] = make()
182:     texB = tB
183:     fboB = fB
184:     gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null)
185:   }

188:     time: number,

190:     height: number,
191:     bindUniforms: (ctx: PassContext, prog: WebGLProgram) => void

193:     if (passes.length === 0) return
194:     ensureFbos(width, height)
195: 
196:     let read: WebGLTexture | null = texA
197:     let writeFbo: WebGLFramebuffer | null = fboB

262: vec2 spUv = 2.0 * p;

309:   glsl: {
310:     dependencies: ['noiseTextureRandomGB'],
311:     functions: `
312: #ifndef TWO_PI
313: #define TWO_PI 6.28318530718
314: #endif
315: vec4 paperVoronoi(vec2 x, float t, float distortion) {
316:   vec2 ip = floor(x);
317:   vec2 fp = fract(x);
318:   vec2 mg, mr;
319:   float md = 8.0;
320:   float rand = 0.0;
321:   for (int j = -1; j <= 1; j++) {
322:     for (int i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
323:       vec2 g = vec2(float(i), float(j));
324:       vec2 oRaw = noiseTextureRandomGB(ip + g);
325:       vec2 o = 0.5 + distortion * sin(t + TWO_PI * oRaw);
326:       vec2 r = g + o - fp;
327:       float d = dot(r, r);
328:       if (d < md) { md = d; mr = r; mg = g; rand = oRaw.x; }
329:     }
330:   }
331:   md = 8.0;
332:   for (int j = -2; j <= 2; j++) {
333:     for (int i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
334:       vec2 g = mg + vec2(float(i), float(j));
335:       vec2 oRaw = noiseTextureRandomGB(ip + g);
336:       vec2 o = 0.5 + distortion * sin(t + TWO_PI * oRaw);
337:       vec2 r = g + o - fp;
338:       if (dot(mr - r, mr - r) > 1e-5) {
339:         md = min(md, dot(0.5 * (mr + r), normalize(r - mr)));
340:       }
341:     }
342:   }
343:   return vec4(md, mr, rand);

395:     functions: `
396: float steppedSmooth(float m, float steps, float softness) {
397:   float stepT = floor(m * steps) / steps;

399:   float fw = steps * fwidth(m);

401:   return stepT + smoothed / steps;
402: }`,

233:   float contour = mix(img[2], 0., shape);

237:   float shadow = shadowShape(animationUV, t, innerBlur);
238:   float shadowCopy = shadowShape(animationUV, tCopy, innerBlur);
239:   float shadowCopy2 = shadowShape(animationUV, tCopy2, innerBlur);

299: export function toProcessedHeatmap(file: File | string): Promise<{ blob: Blob }> {
300:   const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
301:   const canvasSize = 1000;
302: 
303:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
304:     const image = new Image();
305:     image.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
306: 
307:     image.addEventListener('load', () => {
308:       if (typeof file === 'string' ? file.endsWith('.svg') : file.type === 'image/svg+xml') {
309:         // Force SVG to load at a high fidelity size if it's an SVG
310:         image.width = canvasSize;
311:         image.height = canvasSize;
312:       }
313: 
314:       const ratio = image.naturalWidth / image.naturalHeight;
315: 
316:       const maxBlur = Math.floor(canvasSize * 0.15);
317:       const padding = Math.ceil(maxBlur * 2.5);
318:       let imgWidth = canvasSize;
319:       let imgHeight = canvasSize;
320:       if (ratio > 1) {
321:         imgHeight = Math.floor(canvasSize / ratio);
322:       } else {
323:         imgWidth = Math.floor(canvasSize * ratio);
324:       }
325: 
326:       canvas.width = imgWidth + 2 * padding;
327:       canvas.height = imgHeight + 2 * padding;
328: 
329:       const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
330:       if (!ctx) {
331:         throw new Error('Failed to get canvas 2d context');
332:       }
333: 
334:       // 1) Draw original image once, no filters
335:       ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
336:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
337:       ctx.drawImage(image, padding, padding, imgWidth, imgHeight);
338: 
339:       const { width, height } = canvas;
340:       const srcImageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, width, height);
341:       const src = srcImageData.data; // RGBA
342: 
343:       // 2) Build grayscale array (luma)
344:       const totalPixels = width * height;
345:       const gray = new Uint8ClampedArray(totalPixels);
346:       for (let i = 0; i < totalPixels; i++) {
347:         const px = i * 4;
348:         const r = src[px] ?? 0;
349:         const g = src[px + 1] ?? 0;
350:         const b = src[px + 2] ?? 0;
351:         // Standard luma conversion
352:         gray[i] = (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) | 0;
353:       }
354: 
355:       // 3) Blur grayscale for each "filter" you previously used
356:       const bigBlurRadius = maxBlur;
357:       const innerBlurRadius = Math.max(1, Math.round(0.12 * maxBlur));
358:       const contourRadius = 5;
359: 
360:       const bigBlurGray = multiPassBlurGray(gray, width, height, bigBlurRadius, 3);
361:       const innerBlurGray = multiPassBlurGray(gray, width, height, innerBlurRadius, 3);
362:       const contourGray = multiPassBlurGray(gray, width, height, contourRadius, 1);
363: 
364:       // 4) Combine into final ImageData
365:       const processedImageData = ctx.createImageData(width, height);
366:       const dst = processedImageData.data;
367: 
368:       for (let i = 0; i < totalPixels; i++) {
369:         const px = i * 4;
370:         dst[px] = contourGray[i] ?? 0;
371:         dst[px + 1] = bigBlurGray[i] ?? 0;
372:         dst[px + 2] = innerBlurGray[i] ?? 0;
373:         dst[px + 3] = 255;
374:       }
375: 
376:       ctx.putImageData(processedImageData, 0, 0);
377: 
378:       canvas.toBlob((blob) => {
379:         if (!blob) {
380:           reject(new Error('Failed to create PNG blob'));
381:           return;
382:         }
383:         resolve({ blob });
384:       }, 'image/png');
385:     });
386: 
387:     image.addEventListener('error', () => {
388:       reject(new Error('Failed to load image'));
389:     });
390: 
391:     image.src = typeof file === 'string' ? file : URL.createObjectURL(file);
392:   });
393: }

395: /**
396:  * Fast box blur for grayscale images using an integral image.
397:  * gray: Uint8ClampedArray of length width * height
398:  * radius: blur radius in pixels
399:  */
400: function blurGray(gray: Uint8ClampedArray, width: number, height: number, radius: number): Uint8ClampedArray {
401:   if (radius <= 0) {
402:     return gray.slice();
403:   }
404: 
405:   const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(width * height);
406:   const integral = new Uint32Array(width * height);
407: 
408:   // Build integral image
409:   for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
410:     let rowSum = 0;
411:     for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
412:       const idx = y * width + x;
413:       const v = gray[idx] ?? 0;
414:       rowSum += v;
415:       integral[idx] = rowSum + (y > 0 ? (integral[idx - width] ?? 0) : 0);
416:     }
417:   }
418: 
419:   // Blur using integral image
420:   for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
421:     const y1 = Math.max(0, y - radius);
422:     const y2 = Math.min(height - 1, y + radius);
423:     for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
424:       const x1 = Math.max(0, x - radius);
425:       const x2 = Math.min(width - 1, x + radius);
426: 
427:       const idxA = y2 * width + x2;
428:       const idxB = y2 * width + (x1 - 1);
429:       const idxC = (y1 - 1) * width + x2;
430:       const idxD = (y1 - 1) * width + (x1 - 1);
431: 
432:       const A = integral[idxA] ?? 0;
433:       const B = x1 > 0 ? (integral[idxB] ?? 0) : 0;
434:       const C = y1 > 0 ? (integral[idxC] ?? 0) : 0;
435:       const D = x1 > 0 && y1 > 0 ? (integral[idxD] ?? 0) : 0;
436: 
437:       const sum = A - B - C + D;
438:       const area = (x2 - x1 + 1) * (y2 - y1 + 1);
439:       out[y * width + x] = Math.round(sum / area);
440:     }
441:   }
442: 
443:   return out;
444: }
445: 
446: function multiPassBlurGray(
447:   gray: Uint8ClampedArray,
448:   width: number,
449:   height: number,
450:   radius: number,
451:   passes: number
452: ): Uint8ClampedArray {
453:   if (radius <= 0 || passes <= 1) {
454:     return blurGray(gray, width, height, radius);
455:   }
456: 
457:   let input = gray;
458:   let tmp: Uint8ClampedArray = gray;
459: 
460:   for (let p = 0; p < passes; p++) {
461:     tmp = blurGray(input, width, height, radius);
462:     input = tmp;
463:   }
464: 
465:   return tmp;
466: }

1: /** Vertex shader for the shader mount */
2: // language=GLSL
3: export const vertexShaderSource = `#version 300 es
4: precision mediump float;
5: 
6: layout(location = 0) in vec4 a_position;
7: 
8: uniform vec2 u_resolution;
9: uniform float u_pixelRatio;
10: uniform float u_imageAspectRatio;
11: uniform float u_originX;
12: uniform float u_originY;
13: uniform float u_worldWidth;
14: uniform float u_worldHeight;
15: uniform float u_fit;
16: uniform float u_scale;
17: uniform float u_rotation;
18: uniform float u_offsetX;
19: uniform float u_offsetY;
20: 
21: out vec2 v_objectUV;
22: out vec2 v_objectBoxSize;
23: out vec2 v_responsiveUV;
24: out vec2 v_responsiveBoxGivenSize;
25: out vec2 v_patternUV;
26: out vec2 v_patternBoxSize;
27: out vec2 v_imageUV;
28: 
29: vec3 getBoxSize(float boxRatio, vec2 givenBoxSize) {
30:   vec2 box = vec2(0.);
31:   // fit = none
32:   box.x = boxRatio * min(givenBoxSize.x / boxRatio, givenBoxSize.y);
33:   float noFitBoxWidth = box.x;
34:   if (u_fit == 1.) { // fit = contain
35:     box.x = boxRatio * min(u_resolution.x / boxRatio, u_resolution.y);
36:   } else if (u_fit == 2.) { // fit = cover
37:     box.x = boxRatio * max(u_resolution.x / boxRatio, u_resolution.y);
38:   }
39:   box.y = box.x / boxRatio;
40:   return vec3(box, noFitBoxWidth);
41: }
42: 
43: void main() {
44:   gl_Position = a_position;
45: 
46:   vec2 uv = gl_Position.xy * .5;
47:   vec2 boxOrigin = vec2(.5 - u_originX, u_originY - .5);
48:   vec2 givenBoxSize = vec2(u_worldWidth, u_worldHeight);
49:   givenBoxSize = max(givenBoxSize, vec2(1.)) * u_pixelRatio;
50:   float r = u_rotation * 3.14159265358979323846 / 180.;
51:   mat2 graphicRotation = mat2(cos(r), sin(r), -sin(r), cos(r));
52:   vec2 graphicOffset = vec2(-u_offsetX, u_offsetY);
53: 
54: 
55:   // ===================================================
56: 
57:   float fixedRatio = 1.;
58:   vec2 fixedRatioBoxGivenSize = vec2(
59:   (u_worldWidth == 0.) ? u_resolution.x : givenBoxSize.x,
60:   (u_worldHeight == 0.) ? u_resolution.y : givenBoxSize.y
61:   );
62: 
63:   v_objectBoxSize = getBoxSize(fixedRatio, fixedRatioBoxGivenSize).xy;
64:   vec2 objectWorldScale = u_resolution.xy / v_objectBoxSize;
65: 
66:   v_objectUV = uv;
67:   v_objectUV *= objectWorldScale;
68:   v_objectUV += boxOrigin * (objectWorldScale - 1.);
69:   v_objectUV += graphicOffset;
70:   v_objectUV /= u_scale;
71:   v_objectUV = graphicRotation * v_objectUV;
72: 
73:   // ===================================================
74: 
75:   v_responsiveBoxGivenSize = vec2(
76:   (u_worldWidth == 0.) ? u_resolution.x : givenBoxSize.x,
77:   (u_worldHeight == 0.) ? u_resolution.y : givenBoxSize.y
78:   );
79:   float responsiveRatio = v_responsiveBoxGivenSize.x / v_responsiveBoxGivenSize.y;
80:   vec2 responsiveBoxSize = getBoxSize(responsiveRatio, v_responsiveBoxGivenSize).xy;
81:   vec2 responsiveBoxScale = u_resolution.xy / responsiveBoxSize;
82: 
83:   #ifdef ADD_HELPERS
84:   v_responsiveHelperBox = uv;
85:   v_responsiveHelperBox *= responsiveBoxScale;
86:   v_responsiveHelperBox += boxOrigin * (responsiveBoxScale - 1.);
87:   #endif
88: 
89:   v_responsiveUV = uv;
90:   v_responsiveUV *= responsiveBoxScale;
91:   v_responsiveUV += boxOrigin * (responsiveBoxScale - 1.);
92:   v_responsiveUV += graphicOffset;
93:   v_responsiveUV /= u_scale;
94:   v_responsiveUV.x *= responsiveRatio;
95:   v_responsiveUV = graphicRotation * v_responsiveUV;
96:   v_responsiveUV.x /= responsiveRatio;
97: 
98:   // ===================================================
99: 
100:   float patternBoxRatio = givenBoxSize.x / givenBoxSize.y;
101:   vec2 patternBoxGivenSize = vec2(
102:   (u_worldWidth == 0.) ? u_resolution.x : givenBoxSize.x,
103:   (u_worldHeight == 0.) ? u_resolution.y : givenBoxSize.y
104:   );
105:   patternBoxRatio = patternBoxGivenSize.x / patternBoxGivenSize.y;
106: 
107:   vec3 boxSizeData = getBoxSize(patternBoxRatio, patternBoxGivenSize);
108:   v_patternBoxSize = boxSizeData.xy;
109:   float patternBoxNoFitBoxWidth = boxSizeData.z;
110:   vec2 patternBoxScale = u_resolution.xy / v_patternBoxSize;
111: 
112:   v_patternUV = uv;
113:   v_patternUV += graphicOffset / patternBoxScale;
114:   v_patternUV += boxOrigin;
115:   v_patternUV -= boxOrigin / patternBoxScale;
116:   v_patternUV *= u_resolution.xy;
117:   v_patternUV /= u_pixelRatio;
118:   if (u_fit > 0.) {
119:     v_patternUV *= (patternBoxNoFitBoxWidth / v_patternBoxSize.x);
120:   }
121:   v_patternUV /= u_scale;
122:   v_patternUV = graphicRotation * v_patternUV;
123:   v_patternUV += boxOrigin / patternBoxScale;
124:   v_patternUV -= boxOrigin;
125:   // x100 is a default multiplier between vertex and fragmant shaders
126:   // we use it to avoid UV presision issues
127:   v_patternUV *= .01;
128: 
129:   // ===================================================
130: 
131:   vec2 imageBoxSize;
132:   if (u_fit == 1.) { // contain
133:     imageBoxSize.x = min(u_resolution.x / u_imageAspectRatio, u_resolution.y) * u_imageAspectRatio;
134:   } else if (u_fit == 2.) { // cover
135:     imageBoxSize.x = max(u_resolution.x / u_imageAspectRatio, u_resolution.y) * u_imageAspectRatio;
136:   } else {
137:     imageBoxSize.x = min(10.0, 10.0 / u_imageAspectRatio * u_imageAspectRatio);
138:   }
139:   imageBoxSize.y = imageBoxSize.x / u_imageAspectRatio;
140:   vec2 imageBoxScale = u_resolution.xy / imageBoxSize;
141: 
142:   v_imageUV = uv;
143:   v_imageUV *= imageBoxScale;
144:   v_imageUV += boxOrigin * (imageBoxScale - 1.);
145:   v_imageUV += graphicOffset;

147:   v_imageUV.x *= u_imageAspectRatio;
148:   v_imageUV = graphicRotation * v_imageUV;
149:   v_imageUV.x /= u_imageAspectRatio;
150: 
151:   v_imageUV += .5;
152:   v_imageUV.y = 1. - v_imageUV.y;

1: // URL → WebGLTexture cache with LRU eviction and oversize downsampling.
2: // Used by the in-app preview to manage texture lifecycle without thrashing on
3: // every uniform update. Editor-only for now; exported components implement
4: // their own simpler binding.
5: 
6: const MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE = 2048
7: // Upscale tiny / vector images to at least this size so wide-blur shader
8: // sampling doesn't reveal sub-pixel artifacts.
9: const MIN_RASTER_SIZE = 1024
10: // Target SVG rasterization size before upload — matches Paper's preprocessing.
11: const SVG_RASTER_SIZE = 1024
12: const MAX_ENTRIES = 20
13: 
14: interface CacheEntry {
15:   texture: WebGLTexture
16:   width: number
17:   height: number
18:   aspect: number
19:   /** Updated on every getTexture() so eviction picks the oldest. */
20:   lastUsed: number
21: }
22: 
23: export class TextureCache {
24:   private gl: WebGL2RenderingContext
25:   private entries = new Map<string, CacheEntry>()
26:   private placeholder: WebGLTexture | null = null
27:   private inFlight = new Map<string, Promise<CacheEntry | null>>()
28: 
29:   constructor(gl: WebGL2RenderingContext) {
30:     this.gl = gl
31:   }
32: 
33:   /** 1×1 transparent texture; safe to bind unconditionally as a fallback. */
34:   getPlaceholder(): WebGLTexture {
35:     if (this.placeholder) return this.placeholder
36:     const gl = this.gl
37:     const tex = gl.createTexture()
38:     if (!tex) throw new Error('Failed to allocate placeholder texture')
39:     gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex)
40:     gl.texImage2D(
41:       gl.TEXTURE_2D,
42:       0,
43:       gl.RGBA,
44:       1,
45:       1,
46:       0,
47:       gl.RGBA,
48:       gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,
49:       new Uint8Array([0, 0, 0, 0])
50:     )
51:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)
52:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)
53:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
54:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
55:     this.placeholder = tex
56:     return tex
57:   }
58: 
59:   /** Returns a cached entry synchronously if loaded; otherwise null. */
60:   peek(url: string): CacheEntry | null {
61:     const entry = this.entries.get(url)
62:     if (!entry) return null
63:     entry.lastUsed = performance.now()
64:     return entry
65:   }
66: 
67:   /**
68:    * Loads `url` into a texture (cache or fresh). Calls onReady once the
69:    * upload completes so the renderer can re-render with the new texture.
70:    */
71:   prefetch(url: string, onReady?: () => void): void {
72:     if (this.entries.has(url)) return
73:     if (this.inFlight.has(url)) return
74:     const promise = this.load(url).finally(() => this.inFlight.delete(url))
75:     this.inFlight.set(url, promise)
76:     if (onReady) {
77:       promise.then((entry) => {
78:         if (entry) onReady()
79:       })
80:     }
81:   }
82: 
83:   private async load(url: string): Promise<CacheEntry | null> {
84:     const gl = this.gl
85:     const isSvg = isSvgUrl(url)
86:     let source: TexImageSource | null = null
87:     let w = 0
88:     let h = 0
89:     if (isSvg) {
90:       // For SVGs we want to rasterize at MIN_RASTER_SIZE for crisp blur
91:       // sampling. The browser rasterizes <img> elements at the SVG's
92:       // intrinsic size, so even drawing the result at a larger canvas just
93:       // upscales the low-res raster. Instead, fetch the SVG bytes and give
94:       // them a hard width/height inside the SVG markup itself, then load
95:       // the modified SVG via blob URL — that triggers the browser's SVG
96:       // renderer at the requested resolution.
97:       const rasterized = await rasterizeSvgAtSize(url, SVG_RASTER_SIZE).catch(() => null)
98:       if (!rasterized) return null
99:       source = rasterized
100:       w = rasterized.width
101:       h = rasterized.height
102:     } else {
103:       const img = await loadImage(url).catch(() => null)
104:       if (!img) return null
105:       source = img
106:       w = img.naturalWidth
107:       h = img.naturalHeight
108:     }
109:     const limit = Math.min(
110:       MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE,
111:       gl.getParameter(gl.MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE) as number
112:     )
113:     if (w > limit || h > limit) {
114:       const scale = Math.min(limit / w, limit / h)
115:       const dw = Math.max(1, Math.floor(w * scale))
116:       const dh = Math.max(1, Math.floor(h * scale))
117:       const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
118:       canvas.width = dw
119:       canvas.height = dh
120:       const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
121:       if (ctx) {
122:         ctx.drawImage(source as CanvasImageSource, 0, 0, dw, dh)
123:         source = canvas
124:         w = dw
125:         h = dh
126:       }
127:     }
128:     if (!source) return null
129: 
130:     const tex = gl.createTexture()
131:     if (!tex) return null
132:     gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, tex)
133:     gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL, true)
134:     gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_PREMULTIPLY_ALPHA_WEBGL, false)
135:     gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0, gl.RGBA, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, source)
136:     gl.pixelStorei(gl.UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL, false)
137:     // WebGL2 supports mipmaps for arbitrary-size textures. Generating them
138:     // and using LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR eliminates the jagged staircases when
139:     // shader code samples the texture at distances larger than its texel
140:     // size — which is exactly what wide-blur passes do.
141:     gl.generateMipmap(gl.TEXTURE_2D)
142:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR)
143:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR)
144:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
145:     gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE)
146:     const anisoExt = gl.getExtension('EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic')
147:     if (anisoExt) {
148:       const maxAniso = gl.getParameter(anisoExt.MAX_TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT) as number
149:       gl.texParameterf(gl.TEXTURE_2D, anisoExt.TEXTURE_MAX_ANISOTROPY_EXT, Math.min(8, maxAniso))
150:     }
151: 
152:     const entry: CacheEntry = {
153:       texture: tex,
154:       width: w,
155:       height: h,
156:       aspect: w / Math.max(1, h),
157:       lastUsed: performance.now(),
158:     }
159:     this.entries.set(url, entry)
160:     this.evictIfNeeded()
161:     return entry
162:   }
163: 
164:   private evictIfNeeded() {
165:     if (this.entries.size <= MAX_ENTRIES) return
166:     let oldestKey: string | null = null
167:     let oldestUsed = Infinity
168:     for (const [k, v] of this.entries) {
169:       if (v.lastUsed < oldestUsed) {
170:         oldestUsed = v.lastUsed
171:         oldestKey = k
172:       }
173:     }
174:     if (oldestKey) {
175:       const dead = this.entries.get(oldestKey)
176:       if (dead) this.gl.deleteTexture(dead.texture)
177:       this.entries.delete(oldestKey)
178:     }
179:   }
180: 
181:   destroy() {
182:     for (const entry of this.entries.values()) {
183:       this.gl.deleteTexture(entry.texture)
184:     }
185:     this.entries.clear()
186:     if (this.placeholder) {
187:       this.gl.deleteTexture(this.placeholder)
188:       this.placeholder = null
189:     }
190:   }
191: }
192: 
193: function isSvgUrl(url: string): boolean {
194:   if (url.startsWith('data:image/svg+xml')) return true
195:   // Strip query/hash before checking extension.
196:   const base = url.split('?')[0].split('#')[0]
197:   return /\.svg$/i.test(base)
198: }
199: 
200: function loadImage(url: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
201:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
202:     const img = new Image()
203:     // dataURLs and blob URLs don't need crossOrigin; only set for absolute http(s).
204:     if (/^https?:/i.test(url)) img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'
205:     img.onload = () => resolve(img)
206:     img.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Failed to load image: ${url}`))
207:     img.src = url
208:   })
209: }
210: 
211: // Fetch SVG bytes, inject explicit width/height into the <svg> root so the
212: // browser's SVG renderer rasterizes at the desired size, then return an
213: // HTMLImageElement loaded from the modified SVG. This is the reliable way
214: // to force high-resolution SVG rasterization — setting width/height on a
215: // regular <img> element is just a hint that browsers may ignore when the
216: // SVG markup itself declares a size.
217: async function rasterizeSvgAtSize(url: string, targetSize: number): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
218:   let svgText: string
219:   if (url.startsWith('data:image/svg+xml')) {
220:     const comma = url.indexOf(',')
221:     const payload = url.slice(comma + 1)
222:     if (url.slice(0, comma).includes(';base64')) {
223:       svgText = atob(payload)
224:     } else {
225:       svgText = decodeURIComponent(payload)
226:     }
227:   } else {
228:     const fetchOpts: RequestInit = /^https?:/i.test(url) ? { mode: 'cors' } : {}
229:     const res = await fetch(url, fetchOpts)
230:     svgText = await res.text()
231:   }
232:   // Inject (or replace) width/height on the <svg> root element. Preserve
233:   // the viewBox if present so coordinates still map correctly. If the SVG
234:   // doesn't have a viewBox, derive one from the existing width/height to
235:   // keep the content proportional after scaling.
236:   svgText = svgText.replace(/<svg\b[^>]*>/i, (tag) => {
237:     let next = tag
238:     const hasViewBox = /\bviewBox\s*=/i.test(next)
239:     if (!hasViewBox) {
240:       const w = next.match(/\bwidth\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/i)?.[1]
241:       const h = next.match(/\bheight\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/i)?.[1]
242:       if (w && h) {
243:         next = next.replace('<svg', `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${parseFloat(w)} ${parseFloat(h)}"`)
244:       }
245:     }
246:     next = next.replace(/\swidth\s*=\s*"[^"]*"/i, '')
247:     next = next.replace(/\sheight\s*=\s*"[^"]*"/i, '')
248:     next = next.replace('<svg', `<svg width="${targetSize}" height="${targetSize}"`)
249:     return next
250:   })
251:   const blob = new Blob([svgText], { type: 'image/svg+xml' })
252:   const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob)
253:   try {
254:     const img = await loadImage(blobUrl)
255:     return img
256:   } finally {
257:     // Defer revocation so the texture upload reads pixel data from a still-valid bitmap.
258:     setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl), 5000)
259:   }
260: }

2: // React and vanilla components. Kept dependency-free so the exported code is
3: // drop-in usable in any project.
4: //
5: // IMPORTANT: this file is the single source of truth for the export helpers.

7: // so the export and the preview can never drift.

13:   rotation?: number
14:   offsetX?: number
15:   offsetY?: number
16: }

19: export type ImageProp = string | ImageSourceProp | null | undefined
20:
